items.use: 'Al primer intento' = on the first try. Also 'intento' = I try (verb).
items.ex: Lo logró al tercer intento.
items.exEn: He did it on the third try.

items.use: 'Una gran cantidad de' = a large amount of. 'Cantidad de' alone (informal) = loads of.
items.ex: Había una cantidad de gente impresionante.
items.exEn: There was an amazing number of people.

items.use: Formal word for a ship. 'Nave espacial' = spaceship. Also the nave of a church.
items.ex: La nave espacial llegó a la Luna.
items.exEn: The spaceship reached the Moon.
items.latam: In Panama 'la nave' is slang for a car: '¡qué nave!'.

items.use: 'Correr el riesgo' = run the risk. 'Zona de riesgo' = danger zone.
items.ex: No quiero correr ese riesgo.
items.exEn: I don't want to take that risk.

items.use: 'Hacer justicia' = do justice. 'La justicia' also means the courts/law.
items.ex: Las familias piden justicia.
items.exEn: The families are demanding justice.

items.use: The way out, a departure time, or a night out. 'Salida de emergencia'.
items.ex: La salida está al final del pasillo.
items.exEn: The exit is at the end of the hallway.

items.use: 'En tren' = by train. 'Tomar el tren'.
items.ex: Tomamos el tren de Panamá a Colón.
items.exEn: We took the train from Panama City to Colón.

items.use: Same form in singular and plural: la serie, las series. Usual word for a TV show.
items.ex: Estoy viendo una serie nueva en Netflix.
items.exEn: I'm watching a new series on Netflix.

items.use: An economic sector ('sector público') or part of a city.
items.ex: Trabaja en el sector bancario.
items.exEn: She works in the banking sector.

items.use: 'Hacer uso de' = make use of. 'De uso diario' = for daily use. Also 'uso' = I use (verb).
items.ex: Este gel es de uso externo.
items.exEn: This gel is for external use.

items.use: Mostly in set phrases: 'llevar a cabo' = carry out; 'al fin y al cabo' = after all. Also a corporal and a cape (land).
items.ex: Vamos a llevar a cabo el plan en enero.
items.exEn: We are going to carry out the plan in January.

items.use: El corte = a cut: 'corte de pelo', 'corte de luz' (power outage). La corte = a court (of law or royal).
items.ex: Mañana hay corte de agua en el barrio.
items.exEn: There's a water cut in the neighborhood tomorrow.

items.use: Both fingers and toes. 'Dedo del pie' = toe. 'Dedo gordo' = thumb/big toe.
items.ex: Me corté el dedo cocinando.
items.exEn: I cut my finger while cooking.

items.use: 'Tener la esperanza de que' + subjunctive. 'Perder la esperanza' = lose hope.
items.ex: Tengo la esperanza de que todo salga bien.
items.exEn: I hope everything turns out well.

items.use: 'Bajar de peso' = lose weight. 'Subir de peso' = gain weight. Also a currency in several countries.
items.ex: El doctor me dijo que bajara de peso.
items.exEn: The doctor told me to lose weight.

items.use: 'No tener opción' = have no choice. 'La mejor opción'.
items.ex: No tenemos otra opción.
items.exEn: We have no other choice.

items.use: A period of time: 'en esa época' = back then. 'Época de lluvias' = rainy season.
items.ex: En esa época vivíamos en David.
items.exEn: Back then we lived in David.

items.use: 'Un rato' = a while. 'Al rato' = in a little while. 'Pasar un buen rato' = have a good time.
items.ex: Espérame un rato, ya vuelvo.
items.exEn: Wait for me a bit, I'll be right back.

items.use: 'Hace frío' (weather), 'tengo frío' (I feel cold). Never 'estoy frío' for feeling cold.
items.ex: Pon el aire más bajo, tengo frío.
items.exEn: Turn the AC down, I'm cold.
items.latam: In Panama the cold is mostly from the AC ('el aire'). For a head cold, people say 'resfriado' or 'gripe'.

items.use: El testigo / la testigo. 'Testigo de Jehová' = Jehovah's Witness.
items.ex: Ella fue testigo del accidente.
items.exEn: She was a witness to the accident.

items.use: 'En ocasiones' = sometimes. 'De ocasión' = second-hand/bargain.
items.ex: Lo he visto en varias ocasiones.
items.exEn: I've seen him on several occasions.

items.use: Feminine but uses 'el' in the singular: el área, las áreas. 'Área de trabajo'.
items.ex: El área de la piscina cierra a las diez.
items.exEn: The pool area closes at ten.

items.use: El detective / la detective.
items.ex: El detective encontró una pista importante.
items.exEn: The detective found an important clue.

items.use: The marriage, the wedding, or a married couple: 'un matrimonio joven'.
items.ex: Llevan veinte años de matrimonio.
items.exEn: They've been married for twenty years.

items.use: Masculine. 'Árbol de Navidad' = Christmas tree. Accent on á.
items.ex: Hay un árbol de mango en el patio.
items.exEn: There's a mango tree in the backyard.

items.use: 'Con destino a' = bound for. Also fate: 'Fue el destino'.
items.ex: El vuelo con destino a Bogotá está retrasado.
items.exEn: The flight to Bogotá is delayed.

items.use: A physical thing. 'Objetos perdidos' = lost and found. Also a purpose: 'con el objeto de'.
items.ex: Dejé un objeto en el taxi.
items.exEn: I left something in the taxi.

items.use: 'Al sur de' = south of. 'América del Sur', 'Corredor Sur'.
items.ex: Colombia está al sur de Panamá.
items.exEn: Colombia is south of Panama.

items.use: 'Ir al cine' = go to the movies. A single film is 'película'.
items.ex: ¿Vamos al cine el sábado?
items.exEn: Shall we go to the movies on Saturday?

items.use: A protest march, a car gear ('marcha atrás' = reverse), or pace. 'Ponerse en marcha' = get going.
items.ex: Hubo una marcha en la Vía España.
items.exEn: There was a march on Vía España.
items.latam: In Spain 'marcha' also means partying/nightlife; not common in Panama.

items.use: A task or assignment, or a religious/diplomatic mission.
items.ex: Su misión es ayudar a las familias pobres.
items.exEn: Their mission is to help poor families.

items.use: The room, the stove, or a type of food: 'cocina panameña'.
items.ex: Estamos en la cocina preparando el almuerzo.
items.exEn: We're in the kitchen making lunch.
items.latam: In Panama 'estufa' is also common for the stove.

items.use: 'En la isla' = on the island. 'Isla Taboga', 'islas de San Blas'.
items.ex: Vamos a la isla Taboga en ferry.
items.exEn: We're going to Taboga Island by ferry.

items.use: As a noun, 'un enfermo' = a sick person. More often an adjective: 'estar enfermo'.
items.ex: El hospital atiende a los enfermos día y noche.
items.exEn: The hospital cares for the sick day and night.

items.use: Use it for emotions; for physical feelings say 'sensación'.
items.ex: No quiero herir sus sentimientos.
items.exEn: I don't want to hurt her feelings.

items.use: 'La prensa' means journalists and newspapers as a group. 'Rueda de prensa' = press conference.
items.ex: La prensa habló mucho del accidente.
items.exEn: The press talked a lot about the accident.
items.latam: In Panama 'La Prensa' is also the name of a major newspaper.

items.use: Feminine: actriz (plural actrices), not 'actora'.
items.ex: Mi actor favorito es mexicano.
items.exEn: My favorite actor is Mexican.

items.use: All nouns ending in -ción are feminine. Also means 'how well something is organized'.
items.ex: Trabaja para una organización internacional.
items.exEn: She works for an international organization.

items.use: Short form: la tele. 'Ver televisión' (no article needed). The device is often 'el televisor'.
items.ex: Anoche vimos televisión hasta tarde.
items.exEn: Last night we watched TV until late.
items.latam: LatAm often says 'ver televisión' without 'la'; Spain prefers 'ver la televisión'.

items.use: 'Tener prisa' = to be in a hurry. 'Darse prisa' = to hurry up.
items.ex: Lo siento, tengo prisa.
items.exEn: Sorry, I'm in a hurry.
items.latam: In Panama and much of LatAm 'estar apurado' and '¡apúrate!' are more common than 'tener prisa'.

items.use: 'Las autoridades' = officials, police, government. Also an expert: 'una autoridad en el tema'.
items.ex: Las autoridades cerraron la carretera.
items.exEn: The authorities closed the road.

items.use: Often figurative: 'la lucha contra el cáncer'. 'Lucha libre' = wrestling.
items.ex: La lucha contra la corrupción es difícil.
items.exEn: The fight against corruption is hard.

items.use: A thing is 'el modelo'. A person who models is 'el/la modelo' (same form).
items.ex: ¿Qué modelo de celular tienes?
items.exEn: What phone model do you have?

items.use: 'Decir una mentira' = to tell a lie. '¡Mentira!' = No way! / That's not true!
items.ex: Eso es mentira, yo no dije eso.
items.exEn: That's a lie, I didn't say that.

items.use: 'Bolsa de plástico' = plastic bag. 'La Bolsa' = the stock market.
items.ex: ¿Me da una bolsa, por favor?
items.exEn: Can I have a bag, please?
items.latam: In Panama 'cartera' is the usual word for a handbag; Spain says 'bolso'.

items.use: Masculine despite ending in -or like 'la flor'. 'Es un honor' = it's an honor.
items.ex: Es un honor conocerlo.
items.exEn: It's an honor to meet you.

items.use: 'Luna de miel' = honeymoon. 'Estar en la luna' = to be daydreaming.
items.ex: Esta noche hay luna llena.
items.exEn: Tonight there's a full moon.

items.use: Always feminine, even for a man: 'Mi pareja es Juan'. 'En pareja' = in pairs.
items.ex: Vivo con mi pareja en Panamá.
items.exEn: I live with my partner in Panama.

items.use: The organ. Also 'el cerebro del grupo' = the brains behind it. For 'mind' use 'mente'.
items.ex: El cerebro necesita dormir bien.
items.exEn: The brain needs good sleep.

items.use: Inside/house wall. An outdoor wall around a city or property is 'muro' or 'muralla'.
items.ex: Colgamos el cuadro en la pared.
items.exEn: We hung the picture on the wall.

items.use: Also an adjective: 'la vida diaria'. 'A diario' = every day.
items.ex: Escribo en mi diario cada noche.
items.exEn: I write in my diary every night.

items.use: 'Dar una pista' = to give a hint. 'Pista de baile' = dance floor.
items.ex: Dame una pista, no sé la respuesta.
items.exEn: Give me a clue, I don't know the answer.

items.use: Music group or criminal gang. 'Banda ancha' = broadband.
items.ex: Mi banda favorita toca este sábado.
items.exEn: My favorite band plays this Saturday.

items.use: Feminine: heroína (which also means the drug heroin).
items.ex: Mi papá es mi héroe.
items.exEn: My dad is my hero.

items.use: Feminine of 'rey'. Also beauty queen or the chess piece.
items.ex: La reina del carnaval saluda a la gente.
items.exEn: The carnival queen waves to the people.
items.latam: In Panama every town's carnival elects a 'reina'.

items.use: A place to drink. A metal bar is 'barra'.
items.ex: Nos vemos en el bar a las ocho.
items.exEn: See you at the bar at eight.

items.use: 'Tener buena memoria' = to have a good memory. A specific memory is usually 'un recuerdo'. 'De memoria' = by heart.
items.ex: Tengo muy mala memoria para los nombres.
items.exEn: I have a really bad memory for names.

items.use: A newspaper article, a grammar article (el, la) or an item for sale.
items.ex: Leí un artículo interesante sobre el canal.
items.exEn: I read an interesting article about the canal.

items.use: 'En presencia de' = in front of. 'Buena presencia' = smart appearance (common in job ads).
items.ex: Su presencia en la reunión es importante.
items.exEn: Your presence at the meeting is important.

items.use: 'Máquina de lavar' = washing machine. Colloquially, a person who is great at something: '¡Eres una máquina!'.
items.ex: La máquina de café no funciona.
items.exEn: The coffee machine isn't working.

items.use: 'Con permiso' = excuse me (to pass). 'Pedir permiso' = to ask permission. 'Permiso de trabajo' = work permit.
items.ex: Con permiso, ¿puedo pasar?
items.exEn: Excuse me, may I get by?

items.use: Also a theater or cinema showing: 'la función de las ocho'. 'En función de' = depending on.
items.ex: La última función empieza a las diez.
items.exEn: The last show starts at ten.

items.use: 'Dar apoyo' = to give support. Verb: apoyar.
items.ex: Gracias por tu apoyo.
items.exEn: Thanks for your support.

items.use: 'Al estilo de' = in the style of. 'Estilo de vida' = lifestyle.
items.ex: Me gusta tu estilo.
items.exEn: I like your style.

items.use: Means both station and season of the year. 'Estación de metro' = metro station.
items.ex: La estación de metro está cerca.
items.exEn: The metro station is nearby.
items.latam: Panama has two seasons: 'verano' (dry) and 'invierno' (rainy). A gas station is 'una bomba' in Panama.

items.use: Same form singular and plural: el cumpleaños, los cumpleaños. '¡Feliz cumpleaños!'.
items.ex: Mañana es mi cumpleaños.
items.exEn: Tomorrow is my birthday.

items.use: Gender trap: masculine despite -a (el planeta, like el problema).
items.ex: Tenemos que cuidar el planeta.
items.exEn: We have to take care of the planet.

items.use: 'Material escolar' = school supplies. Also an adjective: 'daños materiales'.
items.ex: ¿De qué material es la mesa?
items.exEn: What material is the table made of?

items.use: 'Espíritu Santo' = Holy Spirit. 'Espíritu navideño' = Christmas spirit.
items.ex: Tiene un espíritu muy joven.
items.exEn: She has a very young spirit.

items.use: 'Faltar el respeto' = to be disrespectful. 'Con todo respeto' = with all due respect.
items.ex: Hay que tratar a todos con respeto.
items.exEn: You have to treat everyone with respect.

items.use: Same form for both: el/la teniente.
items.ex: El teniente dio la orden.
items.exEn: The lieutenant gave the order.

items.use: Bomb or pump. '¡Qué bomba!' = what a shock/surprise.
items.ex: Explotó una bomba en el centro.
items.exEn: A bomb exploded downtown.
items.latam: In Panama 'la bomba' is a gas station, and 'bomba' is also a balloon.

items.use: Usually el/la líder. 'Lideresa' exists in LatAm but 'la líder' is more common.
items.ex: Ella es la líder del equipo.
items.exEn: She is the team leader.

items.use: Also a person's nature: 'por naturaleza' = by nature.
items.ex: Me encanta estar en contacto con la naturaleza.
items.exEn: I love being in touch with nature.

items.use: Same form: el/la estudiante. Do not say 'estudianta'.
items.ex: Soy estudiante de español.
items.exEn: I'm a student of Spanish.

items.use: Shape, statue or famous person: 'una figura del deporte'. 'Cuidar la figura' = watch one's figure.
items.ex: Es una figura importante de la música panameña.
items.exEn: He is an important figure in Panamanian music.

items.use: '¡Qué locura!' = how crazy! 'Hacer locuras' = to do crazy things.
items.ex: Manejar con esta lluvia es una locura.
items.exEn: Driving in this rain is madness.

items.use: Feminine despite -l. Also leather/fur: 'una chaqueta de piel'.
items.ex: Usa bloqueador para proteger la piel.
items.exEn: Use sunscreen to protect your skin.
items.latam: For leather LatAm often says 'cuero'.

items.use: The newspaper. Also an adjective: 'de forma periódica' = regularly.
items.ex: Mi abuelo lee el periódico cada mañana.
items.exEn: My grandpa reads the newspaper every morning.

items.use: 'En detalle' = in detail. '¡Qué detalle!' = how thoughtful!
items.ex: Me trajo flores, ¡qué detalle!
items.exEn: He brought me flowers, how thoughtful!

items.use: Usually plural: 'recursos naturales', 'recursos humanos' (HR).
items.ex: El país tiene muchos recursos naturales.
items.exEn: The country has many natural resources.

items.use: 'Las redes sociales' = social media. 'La red' = the internet.
items.ex: Lo vi en las redes sociales.
items.exEn: I saw it on social media.

items.use: Formal. Everyday words: 'la cárcel'. 'Ir a prisión' = to go to prison.
items.ex: Lo condenaron a diez años de prisión.
items.exEn: He was sentenced to ten years in prison.

items.use: Physical fight or quarrel. Verb: pelear(se).
items.ex: Tuvieron una pelea por dinero.
items.exEn: They had a fight about money.

items.use: 'Piedra, papel o tijera' = rock, paper, scissors.
items.ex: El niño tiró una piedra al río.
items.exEn: The boy threw a stone into the river.

items.use: 'Una cerveza bien fría' = an ice-cold beer.
items.ex: ¿Nos tomamos una cerveza?
items.exEn: Shall we have a beer?
items.latam: In Panama a beer is often called 'una fría'.

items.use: Home as a family place; the building is 'casa'. 'Hogar de ancianos' = nursing home.
items.ex: No hay lugar como el hogar.
items.exEn: There's no place like home.

items.use: Stemmed glass: 'una copa de vino'. A plain glass is 'vaso'. 'La Copa del Mundo' = World Cup.
items.ex: ¿Quieres una copa de vino?
items.exEn: Would you like a glass of wine?

items.use: 'Ciencias' (plural) = science subjects. 'Ciencia ficción' = science fiction.
items.ex: Me interesa mucho la ciencia.
items.exEn: I'm very interested in science.

items.use: Office assistant or government official: 'secretario general'.
items.ex: La secretaria le dará una cita.
items.exEn: The secretary will give you an appointment.

items.use: 'Presión arterial' = blood pressure. 'Estar bajo presión' = to be under pressure.
items.ex: El doctor me tomó la presión.
items.exEn: The doctor took my blood pressure.

items.use: 'Tener una conversación' = to have a conversation (not 'hacer').
items.ex: Tuvimos una conversación muy larga.
items.exEn: We had a very long conversation.

items.use: Also general knowledge: 'cultura general'.
items.ex: Me encanta la cultura panameña.
items.exEn: I love Panamanian culture.

items.use: 'Sacar la basura' = take out the trash. 'Bote de basura' = trash can.
items.ex: ¿Puedes sacar la basura?
items.exEn: Can you take out the trash?
items.latam: Trash can: 'tinaquera' (Panama), 'bote/tacho de basura' (LatAm), 'cubo de la basura' (Spain).

items.use: The act or an event. Verb: bailar.
items.ex: El baile típico de Panamá es el tamborito.
items.exEn: Panama's traditional dance is the tamborito.

items.use: Plant or factory. 'Planta baja' = ground floor.
items.ex: Riego las plantas cada mañana.
items.exEn: I water the plants every morning.
items.latam: For floors LatAm says 'piso' more than 'planta'.

items.use: Languages are masculine and lowercase. Feminine for a person: inglesa.
items.ex: Hablo inglés y un poco de español.
items.exEn: I speak English and a little Spanish.

items.use: 'Treinta grados' = 30 degrees. School year: 'sexto grado'.
items.ex: Hoy estamos a treinta y dos grados.
items.exEn: Today it's thirty-two degrees.
items.latam: LatAm uses 'grado' for school years (primer grado); Spain says 'curso'.

items.use: Brand of a product or a mark/stain. 'De marca' = designer/brand-name.
items.ex: ¿De qué marca es tu carro?
items.exEn: What brand is your car?

items.use: A curse or swear. '¡Maldición!' = damn it! (mild).
items.ex: Dicen que la casa tiene una maldición.
items.exEn: They say the house has a curse.

items.use: 'Junta directiva' = board of directors.
items.ex: La junta directiva se reúne el lunes.
items.exEn: The board meets on Monday.
items.latam: In Mexico 'junta' is a common word for a work meeting; Panama mostly says 'reunión'.

items.use: Committee or a sales fee: 'cobrar comisión'.
items.ex: El banco cobra una comisión por cada retiro.
items.exEn: The bank charges a fee for each withdrawal.

items.use: Formal or legal text. 'Por escrito' = in writing.
items.ex: Necesito la respuesta por escrito.
items.exEn: I need the answer in writing.

items.use: 'Tarjeta de crédito/débito'. A playing card or letter is 'carta'.
items.ex: ¿Puedo pagar con tarjeta?
items.exEn: Can I pay by card?

items.use: Writer or perpetrator: 'el autor del crimen'.
items.ex: ¿Quién es el autor de este libro?
items.exEn: Who is the author of this book?

items.use: Meaning changes with gender: 'la capital' = capital city; 'el capital' = money/investment.
items.ex: La capital de Panamá es Ciudad de Panamá.
items.exEn: The capital of Panama is Panama City.

items.use: 'Hacer declaraciones' = to make statements. 'Declaración de renta' = tax return.
items.ex: El ministro hizo una declaración a la prensa.
items.exEn: The minister made a statement to the press.

items.use: 'Hacer un esfuerzo' = to make an effort. 'Con esfuerzo' = with hard work.
items.ex: Con esfuerzo, todo es posible.
items.exEn: With effort, anything is possible.

items.use: Place or art form. 'Hacer teatro' = to act, or to make a scene.
items.ex: Fuimos al teatro el sábado.
items.exEn: We went to the theater on Saturday.

items.use: 'Lograr una victoria' = to win. Opposite: derrota.
items.ex: El equipo celebró la victoria.
items.exEn: The team celebrated the win.

items.use: 'Medios de comunicación' = media.
items.ex: La comunicación en la pareja es clave.
items.exEn: Communication in a couple is key.

items.use: Land, buildings or ownership. 'Propiedad privada' = private property.
items.ex: Esta propiedad está a la venta.
items.exEn: This property is for sale.

items.use: Also figurative: 'un infierno' = a nightmare.
items.ex: El tráfico de hoy fue un infierno.
items.exEn: Today's traffic was hell.

items.use: Seasons are masculine except 'la primavera'. 'En verano' = in summer.
items.ex: En verano vamos a la playa.
items.exEn: In summer we go to the beach.
items.latam: In Panama 'verano' means the dry season (about December to April).

items.use: 'Como consecuencia' = as a result. 'Sufrir las consecuencias' = face the consequences.
items.ex: Cada decisión tiene consecuencias.
items.exEn: Every decision has consequences.

items.use: Usually plural. Sneakers are 'zapatillas' (Spain) or 'tenis' in much of LatAm.
items.ex: Estos zapatos me quedan grandes.
items.exEn: These shoes are too big for me.
items.latam: In Panama sneakers are 'zapatillas' or 'tenis'.

items.use: Plural for skills: 'conocimientos de inglés'. 'Perder el conocimiento' = to pass out.
items.ex: Tiene buenos conocimientos de informática.
items.exEn: He has good computer skills.

items.use: 'Tener la intención de' + infinitive. 'Con buena intención' = with good intentions.
items.ex: No tengo la intención de mudarme.
items.exEn: I have no intention of moving.

items.use: Sports or games player; also gambler.
items.ex: Es el mejor jugador del equipo.
items.exEn: He is the best player on the team.

items.use: Industrial output or a film/show production.
items.ex: La producción de café subió este año.
items.exEn: Coffee production went up this year.

items.use: 'Echar una mirada' = take a look. Often how someone looks at you: 'una mirada triste'.
items.ex: Me lanzó una mirada de enojo.
items.exEn: She gave me an angry look.

items.use: El/la coronel. Mostly in news or military contexts.
items.ex: El coronel habló con los soldados.
items.exEn: The colonel spoke with the soldiers.

items.use: A calendar date only. A romantic date is 'una cita'. 'Fecha de nacimiento' = date of birth.
items.ex: ¿Cuál es la fecha de hoy?
items.exEn: What's today's date?

items.use: -dad nouns are feminine. 'Hacerse responsable' = take responsibility.
items.ex: Cuidar a un perro es una gran responsabilidad.
items.exEn: Taking care of a dog is a big responsibility.

items.use: Number of people living somewhere, or a small town.
items.ex: La población de Panamá es de unos cuatro millones.
items.exEn: Panama's population is about four million.

items.use: Part of something. Colloquially, a shady person: 'ese tipo es un elemento'.
items.ex: El agua es un elemento esencial para la vida.
items.exEn: Water is an essential element for life.

items.use: 'Huevos fritos' = fried eggs. 'Huevos revueltos' = scrambled eggs. Has slang uses, so be careful.
items.ex: Desayuné dos huevos fritos.
items.exEn: I had two fried eggs for breakfast.

items.use: 'Página web' = website. 'En la página diez' = on page ten.
items.ex: Abran el libro en la página veinte.
items.exEn: Open the book to page twenty.

items.use: Also a car jack: 'el gato del carro'.
items.ex: Mi gato duerme todo el día.
items.exEn: My cat sleeps all day.

items.use: Always 'el personaje', even for a woman. Also an eccentric person: '¡Qué personaje!'.
items.ex: Mi personaje favorito de la serie es la abuela.
items.exEn: My favorite character in the series is the grandma.

items.use: Also spelled 'periodo'. Also a woman's menstrual period.
items.ex: Fue un período difícil para la familia.
items.exEn: It was a hard period for the family.

items.use: 'Votar' = to vote. 'Voto secreto' = secret ballot.
items.ex: Mi voto es secreto.
items.exEn: My vote is secret.

items.use: A cut or wound. Adjective: herido/a.
items.ex: Tiene una herida en la pierna.
items.exEn: He has a wound on his leg.

items.use: 'Ganar un premio'. 'Premio gordo' = jackpot.
items.ex: Ganó el premio a la mejor actriz.
items.exEn: She won the award for best actress.
items.latam: In Panama the lottery's top prize is 'el premio mayor'.

items.use: '¡Felicidades!' = congratulations!
items.ex: El dinero no compra la felicidad.
items.exEn: Money doesn't buy happiness.

items.use: Also politeness: 'falta de educación' = rudeness. Do not confuse with 'formación' (training).
items.ex: Es de mala educación hablar con la boca llena.
items.exEn: It's rude to talk with your mouth full.

items.use: 'A propósito' = by the way, or on purpose. 'Propósitos de Año Nuevo' = resolutions.
items.ex: Lo hizo a propósito.
items.exEn: He did it on purpose.

items.use: Same form: el/la artista.
items.ex: Es una artista muy famosa.
items.exEn: She's a very famous artist.

items.use: 'A costa de' = at the expense of.
items.ex: Vivimos en la costa del Pacífico.
items.exEn: We live on the Pacific coast.

items.use: Court of law. 'Llevar a los tribunales' = to take to court.
items.ex: El caso llegó al tribunal.
items.exEn: The case reached the court.

items.use: Ability or max amount: 'con capacidad para 50 personas'.
items.ex: Tiene una gran capacidad de trabajo.
items.exEn: She has a great capacity for work.

items.use: 'En términos de' = in terms of. 'Llevar a término' = to complete. A school term is not 'término'.
items.ex: No entiendo este término técnico.
items.exEn: I don't understand this technical term.

items.use: Months are lowercase in Spanish. 'En julio' = in July.
items.ex: Mi cumpleaños es en julio.
items.exEn: My birthday is in July.

items.use: Piece of a set or machine. 'Pieza de repuesto' = spare part.
items.ex: Le falta una pieza al rompecabezas.
items.exEn: The puzzle is missing a piece.

items.use: 'En teoría' = in theory.
items.ex: En teoría es fácil, pero en la práctica no.
items.exEn: In theory it's easy, but not in practice.

items.use: 'Hacer la tarea' = do homework. 'Tareas de la casa' = chores.
items.ex: Primero haz la tarea y luego juegas.
items.exEn: Do your homework first, then you can play.
items.latam: LatAm 'la tarea' = homework; Spain usually says 'los deberes'.

items.use: Any sound. Unwanted sound is usually 'ruido'.
items.ex: El sonido del mar me relaja.
items.exEn: The sound of the sea relaxes me.

items.use: 'Bosque tropical' = rainforest (also 'selva').
items.ex: Caminamos por el bosque.
items.exEn: We walked through the forest.

items.use: 'De regreso' = on the way back. Verb: regresar.
items.ex: De regreso pasamos por el supermercado.
items.exEn: On the way back we stopped at the supermarket.

items.use: 'En venta' / 'Se vende' = for sale. 'Ventas' = sales department.
items.ex: La casa está en venta.
items.exEn: The house is for sale.

items.use: 'Buscar una solución' = look for a solution. 'No tiene solución' = there's no way to fix it.
items.ex: Tenemos que encontrar una solución.
items.exEn: We have to find a solution.

items.use: Papers, ID. 'Documento de identidad' = ID.
items.ex: Traiga todos sus documentos.
items.exEn: Bring all your documents.
items.latam: In Panama your ID card is 'la cédula'.

items.use: 'Naciones Unidas' = United Nations. Adjective: nacional.
items.ex: Panamá es una nación joven.
items.exEn: Panama is a young nation.

items.use: A framed picture, a square pattern ('a cuadros' = checked) or a chart.
items.ex: Hay un cuadro muy bonito en la sala.
items.exEn: There's a very nice painting in the living room.

items.use: 'Registro civil' = civil registry. Verb: registrar.
items.ex: Hay que hacer el registro en línea.
items.exEn: You have to register online.

items.use: Colloquial and affectionate. Feminine: nena.
items.ex: El nene está dormido.
items.exEn: The little one is asleep.

items.use: Also a resident of an area. Adjective: 'países vecinos'.
items.ex: Mi vecina siempre me saluda.
items.exEn: My neighbor always says hi.

items.use: 'A distancia' = remote ('educación a distancia'). '¿A qué distancia está?' = how far is it?
items.ex: ¿A qué distancia está el aeropuerto?
items.exEn: How far is the airport?

items.use: Real or figurative: 'una batalla legal'.
items.ex: Ganaron la batalla pero no la guerra.
items.exEn: They won the battle but not the war.

items.use: 'Vuelo directo' = direct flight. Verb: volar.
items.ex: Mi vuelo sale a las seis de la mañana.
items.exEn: My flight leaves at six in the morning.

items.use: Also 'una montaña de' = a pile of. 'Montaña rusa' = roller coaster.
items.ex: Tengo una montaña de trabajo.
items.exEn: I have a mountain of work.

items.use: Primary or secondary school. University is 'universidad', not 'colegio' (false friend: college).
items.ex: Mis hijos van al colegio en bus.
items.exEn: My kids go to school by bus.

items.use: 'Tener confianza en' = to trust. 'De confianza' = trustworthy. 'Confianza en uno mismo' = self-confidence.
items.ex: Es una persona de confianza.
items.exEn: She's a trustworthy person.

items.use: 'Hace viento' = it's windy. 'Instrumento de viento' = wind instrument.
items.ex: Hoy hace mucho viento.
items.exEn: It's very windy today.

items.use: Medical treatment or the way you address someone (tú/usted).
items.ex: El tratamiento dura tres semanas.
items.exEn: The treatment lasts three weeks.

items.use: Spain's money before the euro; you'll mostly see it in older texts.
items.ex: Antes del euro, en España se pagaba con pesetas.
items.exEn: Before the euro, people paid in pesetas in Spain.
items.latam: Not used in Panama, where the currency is the balboa / US dollar.

items.use: 'Dueño de casa' = landlord/host. 'Ser dueño de' = to own.
items.ex: El dueño del restaurante es colombiano.
items.exEn: The restaurant owner is Colombian.

items.use: An idea or way of thinking. Verb: pensar.
items.ex: Me leyó el pensamiento.
items.exEn: She read my mind.

items.use: 'Hace calor' = it's hot (weather). 'Tengo calor' = I'm hot. Never 'estoy caliente' (sexual meaning).
items.ex: ¡Qué calor hace hoy!
items.exEn: It's so hot today!
items.latam: Some rural speakers in LatAm say 'la calor', but 'el calor' is standard.

items.use: 'Firmar un contrato'. 'Contrato de alquiler' = lease.
items.ex: Mañana firmo el contrato de trabajo.
items.exEn: Tomorrow I sign the work contract.

items.use: Plural moves the stress: caracteres (no accent). 'Tener mal carácter' = to be bad-tempered. A story character is 'personaje'.
items.ex: Mi jefe tiene mal carácter.
items.exEn: My boss is bad-tempered.

items.use: Same form singular and plural: la crisis, las crisis.
items.ex: El país vive una crisis económica.
items.exEn: The country is going through an economic crisis.

items.use: Polite/informal word for buttocks. Also an adjective: 'la puerta trasera' = back door.
items.ex: Me caí de trasero.
items.exEn: I fell on my behind.

items.use: 'No tiene importancia' = it doesn't matter. 'Dar importancia a' = to give weight to.
items.ex: No le des tanta importancia.
items.exEn: Don't give it so much importance.

items.use: 'Ir de compras' = to go shopping. 'Hacer las compras' = to do the grocery shopping.
items.ex: Voy a hacer las compras al súper.
items.exEn: I'm going to do the shopping at the supermarket.
items.latam: LatAm 'hacer las compras'; Spain 'hacer la compra'.

items.use: Neck or the collar of a shirt.
items.ex: Me duele el cuello.
items.exEn: My neck hurts.

items.use: 'En la práctica' = in practice. 'Hacer prácticas/pasantía' = to do an internship.
items.ex: Con la práctica, hablarás mejor.
items.exEn: With practice, you'll speak better.
items.latam: In Panama an internship is usually 'pasantía'.

items.use: 'Campaña electoral' = election campaign. 'Campaña publicitaria' = ad campaign.
items.ex: La campaña electoral empieza en enero.
items.exEn: The election campaign starts in January.

items.use: El/la sargento. Also a bossy person: 'es un sargento'.
items.ex: El sargento gritó a los soldados.
items.exEn: The sergeant shouted at the soldiers.

items.use: 'Como una bala' = really fast. 'A prueba de balas' = bulletproof.
items.ex: Salió como una bala.
items.exEn: He shot out like a bullet.

items.use: '¡Calma!' = calm down! 'Con calma' = calmly, take your time.
items.ex: Tómalo con calma.
items.exEn: Take it easy.

items.use: 'Tener fe en' = to have faith in. 'De buena fe' = in good faith.
items.ex: Tengo fe en que todo saldrá bien.
items.exEn: I have faith that everything will turn out well.

items.use: Title of a book or a university degree: 'título universitario'.
items.ex: ¿Cuál es el título de la película?
items.exEn: What's the title of the movie?

items.use: Also an adjective: 'es muy trabajador' = he's hard-working.
items.ex: Los trabajadores pidieron un aumento.
items.exEn: The workers asked for a raise.

items.use: 'Un toque de' = a touch of. 'Toque de queda' = curfew. 'Dar un toque' = to give a ring/buzz.
items.ex: Le falta un toque de sal.
items.exEn: It needs a touch of salt.

items.use: Accent: té (tea) vs te (pronoun). 'Té helado' = iced tea.
items.ex: ¿Quieres un té o un café?
items.exEn: Would you like tea or coffee?

items.use: El/la comandante. Also the captain of a plane.
items.ex: El comandante anunció el aterrizaje.
items.exEn: The captain announced the landing.

items.use: El/la colega. Work colleague; in Spain also 'buddy'.
items.ex: Voy a almorzar con un colega.
items.exEn: I'm going to have lunch with a colleague.
items.latam: The 'buddy' meaning is mainly Spain; in Panama say 'amigo' or slang 'pana'.

items.use: 'Curso de inglés' = English course. 'En el curso de' = during.
items.ex: Estoy tomando un curso de cocina.
items.exEn: I'm taking a cooking course.

items.use: Unwanted sound. 'Hacer ruido' = to be noisy.
items.ex: No hagan ruido, el bebé duerme.
items.exEn: Don't make noise, the baby's sleeping.

items.use: Almost always plural: 'tener ganas de' + infinitive = to feel like. 'Me dan ganas de'.
items.ex: Tengo ganas de comer pizza.
items.exEn: I feel like eating pizza.

items.use: A handgun or a tool: 'pistola de silicón'.
items.ex: El policía sacó la pistola.
items.exEn: The police officer took out his gun.

items.use: Feminine: la leche. 'Café con leche'. Has vulgar slang uses in Spain.
items.ex: ¿Me compras leche, por favor?
items.exEn: Can you buy me milk, please?

items.use: Means soccer. American football is 'fútbol americano'. Plural rarely used.
items.ex: Los domingos jugamos fútbol.
items.exEn: On Sundays we play soccer.
items.latam: LatAm 'jugar fútbol'; Spain 'jugar al fútbol'. Also spelled 'futbol' in Mexico.

items.use: 'Vía Láctea' = Milky Way. 'Por vía oral' = orally. 'En vías de' = in the process of.
items.ex: Tomen la vía principal hacia el aeropuerto.
items.exEn: Take the main road to the airport.
items.latam: In Panama major roads are named 'Vía España', 'Vía Argentina', etc.

items.use: 'Código postal' = ZIP code. 'Código de vestimenta' = dress code.
items.ex: ¿Cuál es el código de la red wifi?
items.exEn: What's the wifi code?

items.use: Usually uncountable: 'un pedazo de pan'. 'Pan de molde' = sliced bread.
items.ex: Compré pan para el desayuno.
items.exEn: I bought bread for breakfast.

items.use: Noun with article and accent: 'el porqué'. Don't confuse with 'por qué' (why?) and 'porque' (because).
items.ex: No entiendo el porqué de su decisión.
items.exEn: I don't understand the reason for his decision.

items.use: 'Lavarse los dientes' = brush your teeth. 'Diente de ajo' = garlic clove.
items.ex: Lávate los dientes antes de dormir.
items.exEn: Brush your teeth before bed.

items.use: Level of quality: 'buena calidad'. A personal quality is 'cualidad'.
items.ex: Esta tela es de muy buena calidad.
items.exEn: This fabric is very good quality.

items.use: Verb: amenazar. 'Amenaza de lluvia' = threat of rain.
items.ex: Recibió amenazas por teléfono.
items.exEn: He received threats by phone.

items.use: 'Tener buena actitud'. Note the spelling: actitud (not 'attitud').
items.ex: Me gusta su actitud positiva.
items.exEn: I like her positive attitude.

items.use: Tongue or language: 'lengua materna' = mother tongue.
items.ex: El español es mi segunda lengua.
items.exEn: Spanish is my second language.

items.use: An order for goods or food. 'Hacer un pedido'. A command is 'orden'.
items.ex: Mi pedido llega mañana.
items.exEn: My order arrives tomorrow.

items.use: Area of a country. -ión words are feminine.
items.ex: Es la región más lluviosa del país.
items.exEn: It's the rainiest region in the country.

items.use: 'Dar un beso'. 'Besos' to close messages = love, xoxo.
items.ex: Dale un beso a tu mamá de mi parte.
items.exEn: Give your mom a kiss from me.

items.use: The drug or the field of study: 'estudiar medicina'.
items.ex: ¿Ya te tomaste la medicina?
items.exEn: Did you take your medicine yet?

items.use: 'En oferta' = on sale. 'Oferta de trabajo' = job offer. 'Oferta y demanda' = supply and demand.
items.ex: Estos zapatos están en oferta.
items.exEn: These shoes are on sale.

items.use: 'Pérdida de tiempo' = waste of time. 'Pérdidas' = financial losses.
items.ex: Esa reunión fue una pérdida de tiempo.
items.exEn: That meeting was a waste of time.

items.use: Formal/literary. Everyday word: 'cara'.
items.ex: Tenía una sonrisa en el rostro.
items.exEn: She had a smile on her face.

items.use: Town square, a job opening or a seat. 'Plaza comercial' = shopping mall.
items.ex: Nos vemos en la plaza a las cinco.
items.exEn: See you in the square at five.
items.latam: In Panama a mall is also called 'un mall' or 'centro comercial'.

items.use: Feminine: alcaldesa.
items.ex: El alcalde inauguró el nuevo parque.
items.exEn: The mayor opened the new park.

items.use: The paint itself or a painting. 'Pintura fresca' = wet paint.
items.ex: Compramos pintura azul para el cuarto.
items.exEn: We bought blue paint for the bedroom.

items.use: 'Parque de diversiones' = amusement park. 'Parque nacional'.
items.ex: Los niños juegan en el parque.
items.exEn: The kids play in the park.

items.use: 'Silla de ruedas' = wheelchair. An armchair is 'sillón'.
items.ex: Siéntate en esa silla.
items.exEn: Sit on that chair.

items.use: 'A toda velocidad' = at full speed. 'Límite de velocidad' = speed limit.
items.ex: Iba a mucha velocidad.
items.exEn: He was going very fast.

items.use: A written text. 'Libro de texto' = textbook. Text message: 'mensaje'.
items.ex: Lean el texto y contesten las preguntas.
items.exEn: Read the text and answer the questions.

items.use: 'Tome asiento' = have a seat. 'Asiento de ventana' = window seat.
items.ex: ¿Está libre este asiento?
items.exEn: Is this seat free?

items.use: 'Fuerza de voluntad' = willpower. 'Buena voluntad' = goodwill.
items.ex: Para dejar de fumar hace falta fuerza de voluntad.
items.exEn: Quitting smoking takes willpower.

items.use: 'Laboratorio clínico' = medical lab for blood tests.
items.ex: Tengo que ir al laboratorio a hacerme un examen.
items.exEn: I have to go to the lab for a test.

items.use: 'Decir tonterías' = to talk nonsense. 'Es una tontería' = it's nothing / it's silly.
items.ex: No digas tonterías.
items.exEn: Don't talk nonsense.

items.use: 'Fecha límite' = deadline. 'Sin límite' = unlimited.
items.ex: La fecha límite es el viernes.
items.exEn: The deadline is Friday.

items.use: A truck. The accent disappears in plural: camiones.
items.ex: Un camión bloqueó la calle.
items.exEn: A truck blocked the street.
items.latam: In Mexico 'camión' also means bus; in Panama a bus is 'bus' or 'diablo rojo' (old painted buses).

items.use: Collective noun, used in singular: 'el ganado'. Also the past participle of 'ganar'.
items.ex: En Chiriquí hay mucho ganado.
items.exEn: In Chiriquí there's a lot of cattle.

items.use: The economy or the field of study.
items.ex: La economía de Panamá depende mucho del canal.
items.exEn: Panama's economy depends a lot on the canal.

items.use: 'Una botella de agua'. A baby's bottle is 'biberón' or 'tetero' (Panama).
items.ex: Trae una botella de vino.
items.exEn: Bring a bottle of wine.

items.use: Live show. 'Dar un espectáculo' = to make a scene.
items.ex: El espectáculo empieza a las ocho.
items.exEn: The show starts at eight.

items.use: Eyesight or a point of view: 'visión del futuro'.
items.ex: Tiene una visión clara del proyecto.
items.exEn: She has a clear vision for the project.

items.use: Spelling: restaurante (Spanish adds -e).
items.ex: Conozco un buen restaurante en el Casco Viejo.
items.exEn: I know a good restaurant in Casco Viejo.

items.use: Feminine because 'inteligencia' is feminine: la IA. Same form in plural.
items.ex: Uso la IA para practicar español.
items.exEn: I use AI to practice Spanish.

items.use: Ends in -a but is masculine: el fantasma. As an adjective after a noun it means 'empty, not real': un pueblo fantasma.
items.ex: Mi abuela dice que hay un fantasma en la casa.
items.exEn: My grandma says there is a ghost in the house.

items.use: Common phrases: hacer un pago (make a payment), el pago mensual, pago en efectivo / con tarjeta.
items.ex: Ya hice el pago de la luz.
items.exEn: I already made the electricity payment.

items.use: Use dar un discurso (give a speech). It also means 'the message or line' a politician keeps repeating.
items.ex: El presidente dio un discurso muy largo.
items.exEn: The president gave a very long speech.

items.use: In the news or police talk it means 'an individual, a guy': un sujeto sospechoso. It is NOT 'school subject' (that is materia).
items.ex: La policía detuvo a un sujeto en la esquina.
items.exEn: The police arrested a guy on the corner.

items.use: Alquilar un apartamento = rent an apartment. Often shortened to apto. in ads.
items.ex: Vivimos en un apartamento cerca de la playa.
items.exEn: We live in an apartment near the beach.
items.latam: Spain usually says piso. In Panama apartamento is the normal word.

items.use: Say tener acceso a algo (have access to something). Also used for the way into a place: el acceso al edificio.
items.ex: No tengo acceso a internet en la oficina.
items.exEn: I don't have internet access at the office.

items.use: Used for buildings and for texts or organizations: la estructura del ensayo.
items.ex: La estructura del puente es de acero.
items.exEn: The bridge's structure is made of steel.

items.use: Contar un cuento = tell a story. Un cuento can also be an excuse or a lie: ¡Eso es puro cuento!
items.ex: Le leo un cuento a mi hija cada noche.
items.exEn: I read my daughter a story every night.

items.use: It means both a law-making body and a big professional conference: un congreso de médicos.
items.ex: Fui a un congreso de educación en Ciudad de Panamá.
items.exEn: I went to an education conference in Panama City.
items.latam: Panama's law-making body is the Asamblea Nacional, not a congreso.

items.use: Used for freight (barco de carga), a heavy duty (una carga para la familia) and battery charge.
items.ex: El barco lleva carga a través del Canal.
items.exEn: The ship carries cargo through the Canal.

items.use: A magazine is una revista. Periódico or diario is a newspaper.
items.ex: Compré una revista de cocina en el súper.
items.exEn: I bought a cooking magazine at the supermarket.

items.use: Written km. Speed is kilómetros por hora. Remember the accent: kilómetro.
items.ex: La playa está a veinte kilómetros de aquí.
items.exEn: The beach is twenty kilometers from here.

items.use: Days are lowercase and masculine. Say el viernes (on Friday) and los viernes (on Fridays), with no 'en'. The plural is the same word.
items.ex: Los viernes salimos a comer.
items.exEn: On Fridays we go out to eat.

items.use: The normal word for a computer file: guardar / adjuntar un archivo (save / attach a file).
items.ex: Te mando el archivo por correo.
items.exEn: I'll send you the file by email.

items.use: Rayos y truenos = lightning and thunder. Los rayos del sol = the sun's rays. Rayos X = X-rays.
items.ex: Cayó un rayo cerca de la casa.
items.exEn: Lightning struck near the house.

items.use: Huella digital or huella dactilar = fingerprint. Dejar huella = leave a mark (also figurative).
items.ex: Dejamos huellas en la arena.
items.exEn: We left footprints in the sand.

items.use: Dolor de pecho = chest pain. Dar el pecho = breastfeed.
items.ex: Siento un dolor en el pecho.
items.exEn: I feel a pain in my chest.

items.use: El disco is a record or album; disco duro = hard drive. La disco (short for la discoteca) is a nightclub.
items.ex: Su nuevo disco sale en diciembre.
items.exEn: Her new album comes out in December.

items.use: Lavar los platos = wash the dishes. Plato típico = traditional dish. Primer / segundo plato = first / second course.
items.ex: El sancocho es un plato típico de Panamá.
items.exEn: Sancocho is a traditional Panamanian dish.

items.use: Medio ambiente = the natural environment. Alone, ambiente usually means the mood of a place: buen ambiente.
items.ex: Hay muy buen ambiente en esta oficina.
items.exEn: There's a really good atmosphere in this office.

items.use: Used for research or training centers: instituto de idiomas.
items.ex: Estudio inglés en un instituto por la noche.
items.exEn: I study English at an institute in the evenings.
items.latam: In Spain instituto is a public high school. In Panama high school is colegio.

items.use: A business partner or a club member: hacerse socio del club. It does not mean romantic partner (pareja).
items.ex: Abrió el restaurante con dos socios.
items.exEn: He opened the restaurant with two partners.

items.use: The accent drops in the plural: jardines. Jardín de niños = kindergarten in some countries.
items.ex: Mi mamá tiene flores en el jardín.
items.exEn: My mom has flowers in the garden.
items.latam: In Panama kindergarten is usually kínder or prekínder.

items.use: Masculine: el origen. The plural adds an accent: orígenes. Ser de origen chino = to be of Chinese origin.
items.ex: Muchos panameños son de origen afroantillano.
items.exEn: Many Panamanians are of Afro-Caribbean origin.

items.use: Entrevista de trabajo = job interview. Hacer una entrevista = to interview / do an interview.
items.ex: Mañana tengo una entrevista de trabajo.
items.exEn: Tomorrow I have a job interview.

items.use: Feminine: la nariz. Plural narices (z becomes c). Me sangra la nariz = my nose is bleeding.
items.ex: Tengo la nariz tapada por el resfriado.
items.exEn: My nose is stuffed up from the cold.

items.use: La unión hace la fuerza = unity is strength. Unión libre = living together without marriage.
items.ex: La unión de la familia es lo más importante.
items.exEn: Family unity is the most important thing.

items.use: En conjunto = as a whole. Also a matching outfit or a music group: un conjunto de música típica.
items.ex: Me compré un conjunto nuevo para la fiesta.
items.exEn: I bought a new outfit for the party.

items.use: Pegar un tiro = shoot someone. In sports, tiro libre = free kick / free throw.
items.ex: Se escucharon tres tiros en la calle.
items.exEn: Three shots were heard on the street.

items.use: Unlike English, it can be countable: las evidencias. Poner en evidencia = expose, show up someone.
items.ex: No hay evidencia de que él lo robó.
items.exEn: There's no evidence that he stole it.

items.use: A road between towns. A street in a city is calle. Por carretera = by road.
items.ex: La carretera a David está en buen estado.
items.exEn: The highway to David is in good condition.

items.use: The final j is very soft or silent in speech. Plural relojes. Reloj de pulsera = wristwatch.
items.ex: Mi reloj está atrasado cinco minutos.
items.exEn: My watch is five minutes slow.

items.use: Feminine is princesa. Príncipe azul = Prince Charming.
items.ex: Sigue esperando a su príncipe azul.
items.exEn: She's still waiting for her Prince Charming.

items.use: Used for members of a country and for ordinary people in politics: los ciudadanos exigen respuestas.
items.ex: Todos los ciudadanos tienen derecho a votar.
items.exEn: All citizens have the right to vote.

items.use: Lowercase and masculine. El sábado = on Saturday; los sábados = on Saturdays. No 'en' before days.
items.ex: El sábado vamos a la playa.
items.exEn: On Saturday we're going to the beach.

items.use: Masculine, and the plural is the same: los análisis. Análisis de sangre = blood test.
items.ex: El doctor me mandó a hacer un análisis de sangre.
items.exEn: The doctor sent me to get a blood test.

items.use: Ir a la playa = go to the beach. En la playa = at the beach.
items.ex: Los fines de semana vamos a la playa en Coronado.
items.exEn: On weekends we go to the beach in Coronado.

items.use: Carne de cerdo = pork. Calling a person cerdo means they are dirty or rude.
items.ex: Hoy cocinamos costillas de cerdo.
items.exEn: Today we're cooking pork ribs.
items.latam: In Panama people often say puerco, and also chancho.

items.use: Hacer trampa = cheat (in a game or test). Caer en la trampa = fall into the trap.
items.ex: ¡No se vale hacer trampa!
items.exEn: Cheating isn't allowed!

items.use: The accent drops in the plural: ladrones. ¡Al ladrón! = Stop, thief!
items.ex: El ladrón entró por la ventana.
items.exEn: The thief came in through the window.

items.use: Es mi turno = it's my turn. Turno de noche = night shift. Pedir turno = take a number (in a line).
items.ex: Mi hermana trabaja en el turno de noche.
items.exEn: My sister works the night shift.

items.use: A bit more formal than trabajo: buscar empleo, oferta de empleo. Desempleo = unemployment.
items.ex: Está buscando empleo desde enero.
items.exEn: He has been looking for a job since January.

items.use: Used with the area: Ministerio de Salud, Ministerio de Educación.
items.ex: Tengo que ir al Ministerio de Educación para un trámite.
items.exEn: I have to go to the Ministry of Education to do some paperwork.
items.latam: In Panama ministries are often called by acronyms: MINSA (health), MEDUCA (education).

items.use: A estas alturas = at this point. Estar a la altura = be up to the task. To ask a person's height, use ¿Cuánto mides?
items.ex: El avión vuela a mucha altura.
items.exEn: The plane is flying very high.

items.use: Al comienzo = at the beginning. Same meaning as principio and inicio.
items.ex: Al comienzo no entendía nada.
items.exEn: At the beginning I didn't understand anything.

items.use: Tengo la sensación de que... = I have a feeling that... Also 'a hit' : ser una sensación.
items.ex: Tengo la sensación de que va a llover.
items.exEn: I have a feeling it's going to rain.

items.use: Masculine: el puente. Hacer puente = take the day between a holiday and the weekend off.
items.ex: El Puente de las Américas cruza el Canal.
items.exEn: The Bridge of the Americas crosses the Canal.

items.use: Tomarse un trago = have a drink. Also one swallow: un trago de agua.
items.ex: ¿Vamos a tomarnos un trago después del trabajo?
items.exEn: Shall we grab a drink after work?
items.latam: In Panama and much of Latin America trago is the everyday word for an alcoholic drink; Spain prefers copa.

items.use: Same form for both: el periodista, la periodista. Not 'periodisto'.
items.ex: La periodista entrevistó al alcalde.
items.exEn: The journalist interviewed the mayor.

items.use: False friend: the main meaning is 'stage' in a theater or concert. Subir al escenario = go on stage.
items.ex: La cantante subió al escenario a las nueve.
items.exEn: The singer went on stage at nine.

items.use: Feminine as a noun: la corriente. Estar al corriente = be up to date. Ir contra la corriente = go against the flow.
items.ex: No nades ahí, la corriente es muy fuerte.
items.exEn: Don't swim there, the current is very strong.

items.use: El extranjero also means 'abroad': vivir en el extranjero, viajar al extranjero.
items.ex: Mi hijo estudia en el extranjero.
items.exEn: My son is studying abroad.

items.use: Administración de empresas = business administration (a degree). Also the government in power.
items.ex: Estudió administración de empresas en la universidad.
items.exEn: She studied business administration at university.

items.use: The everyday word for a part of a city. Del barrio = local, from the neighborhood.
items.ex: En mi barrio hay muchas fondas.
items.exEn: There are lots of small diners in my neighborhood.

items.use: En caso de emergencia = in case of emergency. Urgencias (Spain) / emergencias (LatAm) = ER.
items.ex: Lo llevaron al cuarto de urgencias.
items.exEn: They took him to the emergency room.
items.latam: In Panama the ER is el cuarto de urgencias; the emergency number is 911.

items.use: Hacer una propuesta = make a proposal. Propuesta de matrimonio = marriage proposal.
items.ex: El cliente aceptó nuestra propuesta.
items.exEn: The client accepted our proposal.

items.use: A la sombra = in the shade. Sombra de ojos = eyeshadow.
items.ex: Sentémonos a la sombra, que hace mucho calor.
items.exEn: Let's sit in the shade, it's really hot.

items.use: Used for a metal chain, a chain of stores (cadena de supermercados) and a TV network.
items.ex: Me regalaron una cadena de oro.
items.exEn: They gave me a gold chain.

items.use: Spelling trap: monstruo, with -ns-. Can describe a cruel person or, as praise, a genius at something.
items.ex: Mi hijo tiene miedo de los monstruos.
items.exEn: My son is afraid of monsters.

items.use: Used in news and crime reports. Plural keeps the accent: cadáveres.
items.ex: Encontraron un cadáver cerca del río.
items.exEn: A body was found near the river.

items.use: For seasons of the year use estación. Temporada is for periods like temporada de lluvias, temporada alta, or a TV series season.
items.ex: Ya empezó la temporada de lluvias.
items.exEn: The rainy season has already started.

items.use: Used for official bodies, banks, schools, etc.: instituciones públicas.
items.ex: Es una institución que ayuda a niños sin hogar.
items.exEn: It's an institution that helps homeless children.

items.use: Mostly in Su Majestad (Your/His/Her Majesty) for kings and queens. Also 'grandeur'.
items.ex: Su Majestad el rey visitó el país.
items.exEn: His Majesty the king visited the country.

items.use: Almost always plural: las vacaciones. Ir(se) de vacaciones = go on vacation. Estar de vacaciones = be on vacation.
items.ex: En enero nos vamos de vacaciones a Boquete.
items.exEn: In January we're going on vacation to Boquete.

items.use: Common in news. Same idea as tiro, a bit more formal.
items.ex: Los vecinos oyeron varios disparos.
items.exEn: The neighbors heard several shots.

items.use: Tarjeta de crédito = credit card. Pedir un crédito = ask for a loan. Créditos = course credits or film credits.
items.ex: Pagué con tarjeta de crédito.
items.exEn: I paid by credit card.

items.use: Anillo de compromiso = engagement ring. Anillo de boda = wedding ring.
items.ex: Le dio un anillo de compromiso en la playa.
items.exEn: He gave her an engagement ring on the beach.

items.use: Almost always echar un vistazo (a) = take a quick look (at).
items.ex: ¿Puedes echarle un vistazo a mi informe?
items.exEn: Can you take a quick look at my report?

items.use: Accent on the í: tecnología. Tecnología de punta = cutting-edge technology.
items.ex: Mi papá no se lleva bien con la tecnología.
items.exEn: My dad doesn't get along with technology.

items.use: Romperse un hueso = break a bone. Estar en los huesos = be skin and bones.
items.ex: El perro está enterrando un hueso.
items.exEn: The dog is burying a bone.

items.use: Violencia doméstica / de género = domestic / gender violence. Usually singular.
items.ex: La violencia en las calles preocupa a todos.
items.exEn: Violence on the streets worries everyone.

items.use: Mainly 'signature': poner tu firma. Also a company: una firma de abogados.
items.ex: Falta su firma en esta página.
items.exEn: Your signature is missing on this page.

items.use: Tener la conciencia tranquila = have a clear conscience. Tomar conciencia de = become aware of. Perder el conocimiento = lose consciousness.
items.ex: Tengo la conciencia tranquila.
items.exEn: My conscience is clear.

items.use: Salón de belleza = beauty salon. ¡Qué belleza! = How beautiful!
items.ex: La belleza de las islas de San Blas es increíble.
items.exEn: The beauty of the San Blas islands is incredible.

items.use: En construcción = under construction. Trabaja en construcción = he works in construction.
items.ex: Hay mucha construcción en esta zona.
items.exEn: There's a lot of construction in this area.

items.use: Feminine adds -a: escritora. Used for authors of books.
items.ex: Mi escritora favorita es Isabel Allende.
items.exEn: My favorite writer is Isabel Allende.

items.use: No accent in the singular, accent in the plural: exámenes. Hacer / presentar un examen = take an exam.
items.ex: Mañana tengo examen de matemáticas.
items.exEn: Tomorrow I have a math test.

items.use: Often plural for stairs: subir / bajar las escaleras. Escalera eléctrica = escalator.
items.ex: El ascensor está dañado, hay que usar la escalera.
items.exEn: The elevator is broken, we have to use the stairs.

items.use: Estar al mando = be in charge. Mando a distancia = remote control.
items.ex: El capitán está al mando del barco.
items.exEn: The captain is in command of the ship.
items.latam: For the TV remote, Panama says el control; mando is more common in Spain.

items.use: Used for phrases, faces and ideas: una expresión panameña, libertad de expresión.
items.ex: 'Chuleta' es una expresión muy panameña.
items.exEn: 'Chuleta' is a very Panamanian expression.

items.use: Formal word, used in news, signs and police reports. In daily talk say carro.
items.ex: El vehículo quedó mal estacionado.
items.exEn: The vehicle was badly parked.

items.use: Same form for both. Usually means a secret lover in an affair. Amante de = lover of: amante de la música.
items.ex: Soy amante del buen café.
items.exEn: I'm a lover of good coffee.

items.use: La industria del turismo, la industria alimentaria. Industrial is the adjective.
items.ex: La industria del turismo crece cada año.
items.exEn: The tourism industry grows every year.

items.use: Hacer ejercicio = work out (usually singular). Ejercicios = practice exercises in a class.
items.ex: Hago ejercicio tres veces por semana.
items.exEn: I work out three times a week.

items.use: Un pedazo de pan / torta. Hacer pedazos = smash to pieces. Same as trozo.
items.ex: ¿Me das un pedazo de pastel?
items.exEn: Can you give me a piece of cake?

items.use: Comprar un terreno = buy a plot of land. Ganar terreno = gain ground.
items.ex: Compraron un terreno para construir su casa.
items.exEn: They bought a plot of land to build their house.

items.use: For elections and job openings: el candidato al puesto.
items.ex: Hay cinco candidatos a presidente.
items.exEn: There are five presidential candidates.

items.use: Also figurative: el universo de la moda.
items.ex: El universo es más grande de lo que imaginamos.
items.exEn: The universe is bigger than we imagine.

items.use: For the size of objects. For clothes say talla; for shoes, talla or número.
items.ex: ¿De qué tamaño quieres la pizza?
items.exEn: What size pizza do you want?

items.use: Materia is the normal word for a school or university subject. En materia de = regarding.
items.ex: Mi materia favorita es historia.
items.exEn: My favorite subject is history.
items.latam: Spain says asignatura more; in Panama materia is the usual word.

items.use: Tomar / coger un taxi. A taxi driver is un taxista.
items.ex: Tomamos un taxi al aeropuerto.
items.exEn: We took a taxi to the airport.
items.latam: In Latin America say tomar un taxi; avoid coger, which is vulgar in some countries.

items.use: False friend: usually NOT 'compromise'. Tengo un compromiso = I have a prior engagement. Also the engagement before marriage.
items.ex: No puedo ir, ya tengo un compromiso.
items.exEn: I can't go, I already have plans.

items.use: Often plural: en estas circunstancias = under these circumstances. Note: en, not 'bajo', is most common.
items.ex: En estas circunstancias, es mejor esperar.
items.exEn: Under these circumstances, it's better to wait.

items.use: In speech, usually la foto (still feminine). Tomar una foto = take a photo.
items.ex: Me encanta la fotografía de naturaleza.
items.exEn: I love nature photography.

items.use: In stores, existencias (plural) means stock: hasta agotar existencias = while supplies last.
items.ex: Oferta válida hasta agotar existencias.
items.exEn: Offer valid while supplies last.

items.use: Firmar un tratado = sign a treaty. Tratado de libre comercio = free trade agreement.
items.ex: Los tratados Torrijos-Carter devolvieron el Canal a Panamá.
items.exEn: The Torrijos-Carter Treaties returned the Canal to Panama.

items.use: False friend: gas is cooking gas or a gas in science. Car fuel is gasolina. Plural gases.
items.ex: Se acabó el gas de la estufa.
items.exEn: The stove ran out of gas.
items.latam: In Panama a cooking gas tank is un tanque de gas or una pipa.

items.use: ¡Es un robo! = That's a rip-off! The verb is robar.
items.ex: Denuncié el robo de mi celular.
items.exEn: I reported the theft of my cell phone.

items.use: Empleado público = government employee. Empleada (doméstica) is also used for a housekeeper.
items.ex: La empresa tiene cincuenta empleados.
items.exEn: The company has fifty employees.

items.use: Una hoja de papel = a sheet of paper. Hoja de vida = CV/resume in many Latin American countries.
items.ex: ¿Me prestas una hoja?
items.exEn: Can you lend me a sheet of paper?
items.latam: Panama says hoja de vida for a resume; Spain says currículum.

items.use: Protección solar = sunscreen. Protección de datos = data protection.
items.ex: Usa protección solar en la playa.
items.exEn: Use sunscreen at the beach.

items.use: Dar un paseo = go for a walk. Ir de paseo = go on an outing.
items.ex: Fuimos de paseo a El Valle.
items.exEn: We went on a trip to El Valle.

items.use: En busca de / en búsqueda de = in search of. Also an online search.
items.ex: La búsqueda del niño duró dos días.
items.exEn: The search for the boy lasted two days.

items.use: Masculine: el canal. El Canal de Panamá. Cambiar de canal = change the channel.
items.ex: Los barcos esperan para cruzar el Canal.
items.exEn: The ships wait to cross the Canal.

items.use: Ser experto en algo = be an expert in something (use en, not 'de').
items.ex: Mi tío es experto en computadoras.
items.exEn: My uncle is a computer expert.

items.use: In Spain mono is also cute (adjective) or coveralls; in Latin America it is mainly the animal.
items.ex: En la isla vimos monos aulladores.
items.exEn: On the island we saw howler monkeys.

items.use: Cutlery: cuchillo, tenedor (fork), cuchara (spoon).
items.ex: Este cuchillo no corta nada.
items.exEn: This knife doesn't cut at all.

items.use: Also 'item' on a bill: en concepto de = as payment for.
items.ex: No entiendo bien ese concepto.
items.exEn: I don't really understand that concept.

items.use: Lowercase, masculine, same plural: el lunes, los lunes. No 'en' before days.
items.ex: El lunes empiezo en mi nuevo trabajo.
items.exEn: On Monday I start my new job.

items.use: More formal than pelo; common in ads and salons. Use the singular for all of your hair.
items.ex: Tiene el cabello largo y rizado.
items.exEn: She has long, curly hair.

items.use: Los beneficios del ejercicio = the benefits of exercise. A beneficio de = for the benefit of.
items.ex: Este trabajo tiene buenos beneficios.
items.exEn: This job has good benefits.

items.use: Accent on the first e: método. Método de pago = payment method.
items.ex: Cada profesor tiene su propio método.
items.exEn: Every teacher has their own method.

items.use: Any drink, alcoholic or not. On menus: bebidas.
items.ex: ¿Qué bebida quieres con tu almuerzo?
items.exEn: What drink do you want with your lunch?
items.latam: In Panama una soda is a soft drink.

items.use: Tener deudas = be in debt. Estar en deuda con alguien = owe someone (also a favor).
items.ex: Por fin pagué todas mis deudas.
items.exEn: I finally paid off all my debts.

items.use: Not a door key (that is llave). La clave del éxito = the key to success. Also a PIN or password. As an adjective: un punto clave.
items.ex: Olvidé la clave del wifi.
items.exEn: I forgot the wifi password.

items.use: Often plural: las normas de la casa. Seguir / cumplir las normas = follow the rules.
items.ex: Hay que respetar las normas del edificio.
items.exEn: You have to respect the building's rules.

items.use: Used for police detectives and official inspectors.
items.ex: El inspector revisó la cocina del restaurante.
items.exEn: The inspector checked the restaurant's kitchen.

items.use: Cinta adhesiva = sticky tape. Cinta métrica = tape measure. Also a hair ribbon.
items.ex: Necesito cinta para cerrar la caja.
items.exEn: I need tape to close the box.

items.use: Poner una demanda = file a lawsuit. Oferta y demanda = supply and demand.
items.ex: Le puso una demanda a la empresa.
items.exEn: He filed a lawsuit against the company.

items.use: Tener ritmo = have rhythm (dancing). A este ritmo = at this rate.
items.ex: A este ritmo no vamos a terminar hoy.
items.exEn: At this rate we won't finish today.

items.use: Any round ball. For sports balls, pelota is more common in many countries; balón is a big ball (soccer).
items.ex: Hizo una bola de papel y la tiró a la basura.
items.exEn: He made a ball of paper and threw it in the trash.

items.use: Ventajas y desventajas = pros and cons. Sacar ventaja = take advantage, get ahead.
items.ex: Hablar inglés es una gran ventaja.
items.exEn: Speaking English is a big advantage.

items.use: Same form for both: el / la representante.
items.ex: Habla con el representante de ventas.
items.exEn: Talk to the sales representative.
items.latam: In Panama a representante is also an elected local official of a corregimiento.

items.use: Used for groups and clubs: asociación de vecinos.
items.ex: Es miembro de una asociación de médicos.
items.exEn: He's a member of a medical association.

items.use: Both el pantalón and los pantalones mean one pair. Pantalones cortos = shorts.
items.ex: Me compré unos pantalones negros.
items.exEn: I bought a pair of black pants.

items.use: The verb is llover: está lloviendo. Lluvia de ideas = brainstorming.
items.ex: Con esta lluvia no podemos salir.
items.exEn: We can't go out in this rain.

items.use: Versión original = original version (movies not dubbed). Also someone's side of a story.
items.ex: Cada uno tiene su versión de lo que pasó.
items.exEn: Everyone has their own version of what happened.

items.use: A personal goal or the finish line in a race. A goal in soccer is gol.
items.ex: Mi meta es aprobar el DELE este año.
items.exEn: My goal is to pass the DELE this year.

items.use: The accent drops in the plural: autobuses. Tomar el autobús = take the bus.
items.ex: El autobús pasa cada veinte minutos.
items.exEn: The bus comes every twenty minutes.
items.latam: In Panama people just say el bus; a small bus is a busito or chiva.

items.use: Feminine enfermera. Not related to enfermo (sick), but same root.
items.ex: La enfermera me tomó la presión.
items.exEn: The nurse took my blood pressure.

items.use: Accent on the u: república. La República de Panamá.
items.ex: Panamá se separó de Colombia y se hizo república en 1903.
items.exEn: Panama separated from Colombia and became a republic in 1903.

items.use: Encender / apagar el motor = start / turn off the engine. Also a driving force.
items.ex: El motor del carro hace un ruido raro.
items.exEn: The car's engine is making a strange noise.

items.use: Hacer una inversión = make an investment. The verb is invertir.
items.ex: Comprar esta casa fue una buena inversión.
items.exEn: Buying this house was a good investment.

items.use: Agencia de viajes = travel agency. Also a branch office.
items.ex: Reservamos el viaje en una agencia.
items.exEn: We booked the trip through an agency.

items.use: Masculine: el desastre. ¡Qué desastre! = What a mess! Ser un desastre = be hopeless/messy.
items.ex: Mi cuarto es un desastre.
items.exEn: My room is a mess.

items.use: Polite word for a woman: damas y caballeros. Damas (plural) is also the game of checkers. Dama de honor = bridesmaid.
items.ex: Damas y caballeros, bienvenidos.
items.exEn: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome.

items.use: A corto / largo plazo = in the short / long term. Pagar a plazos = pay in installments. Vence el plazo = the deadline expires.
items.ex: El plazo para entregar el proyecto es el viernes.
items.exEn: The deadline to hand in the project is Friday.

items.use: Noun or adjective: un borracho / está borracho. Use estar for the temporary state.
items.ex: Un borracho estaba gritando en la calle.
items.exEn: A drunk was shouting in the street.

items.use: More formal than comida; used for health and labels: alimentos saludables.
items.ex: Debes comer alimentos con más fibra.
items.exEn: You should eat foods with more fiber.

items.use: Una etapa de la vida = a stage of life. Por etapas = in stages.
items.ex: La adolescencia es una etapa difícil.
items.exEn: Adolescence is a hard stage.

items.use: Not a letter you mail (that is carta). La letra de la canción = the lyrics. Tener buena letra = have nice handwriting.
items.ex: No entiendo tu letra.
items.exEn: I can't read your handwriting.

items.use: Used for an actor's or artist's performance, and for how police or officials acted.
items.ex: Su actuación en la película fue excelente.
items.exEn: Her performance in the movie was excellent.

items.use: Formación profesional = vocational training. Often used in job ads for qualifications.
items.ex: Busca personas con formación en contabilidad.
items.exEn: They're looking for people with training in accounting.

items.use: La competencia = the competition (rival companies or a contest). Competencias = skills.
items.ex: Ganó la competencia de natación.
items.exEn: She won the swimming competition.
items.latam: Latin America uses competencia for a sports contest; Spain prefers competición.

items.use: The usual word for a ball you play with. Jugar a la pelota = play ball.
items.ex: Los niños están jugando con la pelota en el parque.
items.exEn: The kids are playing ball in the park.

items.use: Pagar impuestos = pay taxes. Impuesto sobre la renta = income tax.
items.ex: El precio no incluye el impuesto.
items.exEn: The price doesn't include tax.
items.latam: In Panama sales tax is called ITBMS (7%).

items.use: A book-length story. In Latin America novela also means telenovela (TV soap opera).
items.ex: Mi abuela ve la novela todas las noches.
items.exEn: My grandma watches the soap opera every night.

items.use: Silla de ruedas = wheelchair. Rueda de prensa = press conference.
items.ex: Se le pinchó una rueda en la carretera.
items.exEn: He got a flat tire on the highway.
items.latam: For a car tire, Panama usually says llanta.

items.use: For political change and big changes in general: una revolución tecnológica.
items.ex: El celular fue una revolución en la comunicación.
items.exEn: The cell phone was a revolution in communication.

items.use: Dar la bienvenida a alguien = welcome someone. Fiesta de bienvenida = welcome party.
items.ex: Le dimos la bienvenida al nuevo compañero.
items.exEn: We welcomed the new coworker.

items.use: A hole in something: un agujero en la camisa. A pothole in the road is un hueco.
items.ex: Mis medias tienen un agujero.
items.exEn: My socks have a hole.

items.use: Cometer un delito = commit a crime. Delito is any offense; crimen is usually a serious one, often murder.
items.ex: Manejar borracho es un delito.
items.exEn: Driving drunk is a crime.

items.use: Estar de buen / mal humor = be in a good / bad mood. Sentido del humor = sense of humor.
items.ex: Hoy mi jefe está de mal humor.
items.exEn: My boss is in a bad mood today.

items.use: Pez is a live fish; pescado is fish as food. Plural peces (z becomes c).
items.ex: Vimos peces de colores en el arrecife.
items.exEn: We saw colorful fish on the reef.

items.use: Un factor clave = a key factor. Factor de riesgo = risk factor.
items.ex: El precio es un factor importante.
items.exEn: Price is an important factor.

items.use: Sentir un vacío = feel empty. Empacado al vacío = vacuum-packed.
items.ex: Su muerte dejó un vacío en la familia.
items.exEn: His death left a void in the family.

items.use: Salón de clases = classroom. Salón de eventos = event hall. Salón de belleza = beauty salon.
items.ex: El salón de clases tiene aire acondicionado.
items.exEn: The classroom has air conditioning.
items.latam: In Spain salón is the living room; in Panama the living room is la sala.

items.use: Content of a container or of media: crear contenido para redes.
items.ex: Ella crea contenido para Instagram.
items.exEn: She creates content for Instagram.

items.use: Con hielo = on the rocks / with ice. Romper el hielo = break the ice.
items.ex: Un jugo con mucho hielo, por favor.
items.exEn: A juice with lots of ice, please.

items.use: Tomar un descanso = take a break. Día de descanso = day off.
items.ex: Vamos a tomar un descanso de diez minutos.
items.exEn: Let's take a ten-minute break.

items.use: Usually adventure: película de aventuras. With a person it can mean a short affair.
items.ex: El viaje por Darién fue toda una aventura.
items.exEn: The trip through Darién was quite an adventure.

items.use: A noble title. Feminine is condesa.
items.ex: El conde vivía en un castillo.
items.exEn: The count lived in a castle.

items.use: Entre la espada y la pared = between a rock and a hard place.
items.ex: Estoy entre la espada y la pared.
items.exEn: I'm between a rock and a hard place.

items.use: Quitar el polvo = dust (furniture). En polvo = powdered: leche en polvo. Avoid it in slang phrases, where it can be vulgar.
items.ex: Los muebles están llenos de polvo.
items.exEn: The furniture is covered in dust.

items.use: Recibir críticas = get criticism. Also a film or book review.
items.ex: La película recibió buenas críticas.
items.exEn: The movie got good reviews.

items.en: map (of a city), plan (of a building); level
items.use: A city map or floor plan. En primer plano = in the foreground. En el plano personal = on a personal level.
items.ex: El arquitecto nos mostró los planos de la casa.
items.exEn: The architect showed us the plans for the house.

items.use: Cruzar la frontera = cross the border. Fronterizo = border (adjective).
items.ex: Paso Canoas está en la frontera con Costa Rica.
items.exEn: Paso Canoas is on the border with Costa Rica.

items.use: A student of a school or teacher. Estudiante (mf) is more general, especially at university.
items.ex: La profesora tiene treinta alumnos.
items.exEn: The teacher has thirty students.

items.use: False friend: often a single talk or lecture. Conferencia de prensa = press conference.
items.ex: Mañana doy una conferencia sobre el medio ambiente.
items.exEn: Tomorrow I'm giving a talk on the environment.

items.use: El jurado = the jury or panel of judges. A single member can be el / la jurado.
items.ex: El jurado eligió a la ganadora del concurso.
items.exEn: The judges chose the winner of the contest.

items.use: A glass for drinking. Copa = wine glass. Vidrio = glass the material.
items.ex: ¿Me das un vaso de agua?
items.exEn: Can I have a glass of water?

items.use: Capital D for the God of one religion: Dios. Very common in phrases: si Dios quiere, gracias a Dios.
items.ex: Los griegos tenían muchos dioses.
items.exEn: The Greeks had many gods.
items.latam: Panamanians often add si Dios quiere when talking about plans.

items.use: Ejecutivo de ventas / de cuentas = sales / account executive.
items.ex: Su esposa es ejecutiva de un banco.
items.exEn: His wife is a bank executive.

items.use: Usually a hat with a brim. A cap is una gorra.
items.ex: Se puso el sombrero para protegerse del sol.
items.exEn: He put on his hat to protect himself from the sun.
items.latam: The traditional Panamanian hat is the sombrero pintao.

items.use: Territorio nacional = national territory.
items.ex: Esa isla es territorio panameño.
items.exEn: That island is Panamanian territory.

items.use: Also used for big official buildings: palacio de gobierno, palacio de justicia.
items.ex: El Palacio de las Garzas está en el Casco Viejo.
items.exEn: The Palace of the Herons is in the Casco Viejo.

items.use: De generación en generación = from generation to generation.
items.ex: La receta pasó de generación en generación.
items.exEn: The recipe was passed down from generation to generation.

items.use: For people from India, also hindú. For Indigenous peoples say indígena: indio can sound offensive.
items.ex: En mi oficina trabaja un ingeniero indio.
items.exEn: An Indian engineer works in my office.

items.use: Pájaro is a small bird; ave is any bird and more formal. Matar dos pájaros de un tiro = kill two birds with one stone.
items.ex: Los pájaros cantan temprano en la mañana.
items.exEn: The birds sing early in the morning.

items.use: Months are lowercase: en mayo, el 5 de mayo.
items.ex: Las lluvias empiezan en mayo.
items.exEn: The rains start in May.

items.use: Iniciar / cerrar sesión = log in / log out. Sesión de fotos = photo shoot.
items.ex: Olvidé cerrar sesión en la computadora.
items.exEn: I forgot to log out of the computer.

items.use: Masculine, plural comités. Formar parte de un comité = be on a committee.
items.ex: El comité se reúne cada mes.
items.exEn: The committee meets every month.

items.use: A big rock. A small stone is una piedra.
items.ex: Nos sentamos en una roca frente al mar.
items.exEn: We sat on a rock facing the sea.

items.use: Living thing, the human body, or an official body: organismo internacional.
items.ex: El agua es esencial para el organismo.
items.exEn: Water is essential for the body.

items.use: In everyday Spanish frase often means a full sentence. Grammar books say oración.
items.ex: Escribe una frase con esta palabra.
items.exEn: Write a sentence with this word.

items.use: Picture or door frame. En el marco de = within the framework of, as part of.
items.ex: Compré un marco para la foto de la boda.
items.exEn: I bought a frame for the wedding photo.

items.use: Note the double c: reacción. Reacción alérgica = allergic reaction.
items.ex: Tuvo una reacción alérgica al marisco.
items.exEn: She had an allergic reaction to the seafood.

items.use: Often plural for product features: las características del teléfono.
items.ex: ¿Cuáles son las características de este modelo?
items.exEn: What are the features of this model?

items.use: El Reino Unido = the United Kingdom. Reino animal = animal kingdom.
items.ex: Mi prima vive en el Reino Unido.
items.exEn: My cousin lives in the United Kingdom.

items.use: Hacer / practicar deporte = do sports. Not 'jugar deporte'.
items.ex: El béisbol es el deporte más popular en Panamá.
items.exEn: Baseball is the most popular sport in Panama.

items.use: Often plural: gastos de la casa, gastos de envío (shipping costs).
items.ex: Este mes tuvimos muchos gastos.
items.exEn: This month we had lots of expenses.

items.use: ¡Qué emoción! = How exciting! It often means excitement, not just a feeling.
items.ex: ¡Qué emoción, mañana nos vamos de viaje!
items.exEn: How exciting, tomorrow we leave on our trip!

items.use: Conflicto de intereses = conflict of interest. Entrar en conflicto = come into conflict.
items.ex: Prefiero evitar los conflictos en el trabajo.
items.exEn: I prefer to avoid conflicts at work.

items.use: Encogerse de hombros = shrug. Me duele el hombro = my shoulder hurts (use el, not 'mi').
items.ex: Me duele el hombro de cargar la mochila.
