items.exEn: My shoulder hurts from carrying the backpack.

items.use: Pollo is chicken as food. The live adult hen is la gallina. Common: pollo frito, pollo asado, arroz con pollo.
items.ex: De almuerzo hay arroz con pollo.
items.exEn: There's chicken and rice for lunch.

items.use: All nouns ending in -dad are feminine. Say tener dificultades para + infinitive, or con dificultad (with difficulty).
items.ex: Tiene dificultades para dormir.
items.exEn: He has trouble sleeping.

items.use: Masculine although it is a body part. Lip balm is bálsamo labial; lipstick is pintalabios or lápiz labial.
items.ex: Tengo los labios secos por el sol.
items.exEn: My lips are dry from the sun.

items.use: Los primos can mean male cousins or a mixed group. A female cousin is la prima. Número primo is a prime number.
items.ex: Mis primos viven en Chiriquí.
items.exEn: My cousins live in Chiriquí.
items.latam: Among friends, primo is also a casual way to say 'bro' in parts of the Caribbean and Central America.

items.use: Nouns in -ción are feminine. The accent drops in the plural: explicaciones. Dar una explicación = to give an explanation.
items.ex: No me dio ninguna explicación.
items.exEn: He didn't give me any explanation.

items.use: Feminine like all -dad nouns. Use tener habilidad para + noun/infinitive. Soft skills are habilidades blandas.
items.ex: Tiene mucha habilidad para los idiomas.
items.exEn: She has a real gift for languages.

items.use: La bruja is the witch of stories; el brujo is often a folk healer or sorcerer people consult.
items.ex: Dicen que el brujo del pueblo cura con plantas.
items.exEn: They say the village sorcerer heals with plants.

items.use: Used for a team coach and a personal trainer (entrenador personal). The verb is entrenar.
items.ex: El entrenador cambió a tres jugadores.
items.exEn: The coach changed three players.

items.use: Formal word for official steps, legal or medical procedures. Seguir el procedimiento = follow the procedure.
items.ex: El procedimiento para renovar la cédula es sencillo.
items.exEn: The procedure to renew your ID card is simple.

items.use: Mostly 'embarrassment': me da vergüenza = I'm embarrassed. Avoid 'embarazada' for embarrassed (it means pregnant). ¡Qué vergüenza! = How embarrassing!
items.ex: Me da vergüenza hablar en público.
items.exEn: I'm embarrassed to speak in public.
items.latam: Many Latin Americans also say pena: me da pena = I'm embarrassed.

items.use: Used for book chapters and TV episodes. Stress on the second syllable: ca-PÍ-tu-lo.
items.ex: Anoche vi tres capítulos de la serie.
items.exEn: Last night I watched three episodes of the series.

items.use: Masculine, no article in general statements after verbs like tomar: no tomo alcohol. Also rubbing alcohol for cleaning.
items.ex: No puedes manejar si tomaste alcohol.
items.exEn: You can't drive if you've been drinking alcohol.

items.use: Masculine because it ends in puerto. Ir al aeropuerto, recoger a alguien en el aeropuerto.
items.ex: Te recojo en el aeropuerto a las seis.
items.exEn: I'll pick you up at the airport at six.

items.use: Masculine despite ending in -or like la flor. Say olor a + noun: olor a café (smell of coffee). The verb is oler (huele).
items.ex: Hay un olor a quemado en la cocina.
items.exEn: There's a burning smell in the kitchen.

items.use: Pedir un aumento = ask for a raise. Use aumento de + noun: aumento de precios, aumento de sueldo.
items.ex: Le pedí un aumento a mi jefe.
items.exEn: I asked my boss for a raise.

items.use: Feminine like all -dad nouns. Usually with en: en la oscuridad (in the dark).
items.ex: Mi hijo le tiene miedo a la oscuridad.
items.exEn: My son is afraid of the dark.

items.use: Dar un grito = to shout. A gritos = shouting. 'El último grito' means the latest fashion.
items.ex: Escuchamos un grito en la calle.
items.exEn: We heard a scream in the street.

items.use: Very common in school and work contexts. Similar to conducta; the verb is comportarse.
items.ex: Su comportamiento en clase ha mejorado.
items.exEn: His behavior in class has improved.

items.use: Feminine (-dad). Documento de identidad = ID document; robo de identidad = identity theft.
items.ex: Necesita un documento de identidad para entrar.
items.exEn: You need an ID document to enter.
items.latam: In Panama the national ID card is called la cédula.

items.use: Prisionero is a captive, often of war. Someone serving a jail sentence is usually un preso or una presa.
items.ex: Liberaron a los prisioneros después de la guerra.
items.exEn: They freed the prisoners after the war.

items.use: Feminine. Also means the area of land or a home in square meters. En la superficie = on the surface.
items.ex: Limpia bien la superficie de la mesa.
items.exEn: Clean the surface of the table well.

items.use: Madera is wood as material: una mesa de madera. Firewood is leña; a forest is un bosque.
items.ex: La casa tiene piso de madera.
items.exEn: The house has a wooden floor.

items.use: A magic trick or a handy tip: un truco para + infinitive. Tiene truco = there's a catch.
items.ex: Te enseño un truco para pelar ajo rápido.
items.exEn: I'll show you a trick to peel garlic fast.

items.use: Dough for bread or pizza. Also mass in physics, and the masses (las masas). En masa = en masse.
items.ex: Deja reposar la masa una hora.
items.exEn: Let the dough rest for an hour.

items.use: Same form for men and women: el piloto, la piloto. Also a test version: un programa piloto.
items.ex: La piloto anunció que vamos a aterrizar.
items.exEn: The pilot announced that we're going to land.

items.use: Lowercase in Spanish. Al oeste de = to the west of. Panamá Oeste is a province (capitalized as a name).
items.ex: El sol se pone por el oeste.
items.exEn: The sun sets in the west.

items.use: Polite but a bit formal. In everyday speech people often say persona mayor or adulto mayor.
items.ex: El anciano se sentó a descansar en el parque.
items.exEn: The old man sat down to rest in the park.
items.latam: In Panama and much of Latin America the official, respectful term is adulto mayor.

items.use: Tener talento para + noun/infinitive. Also used for a talented person: es un talento.
items.ex: Tiene talento para la música.
items.exEn: She has a talent for music.

items.use: The masculine is el príncipe. Also an affectionate word for a little girl: mi princesa.
items.ex: A mi hija le encantan los cuentos de princesas.
items.exEn: My daughter loves princess stories.

items.use: Masculine. Transporte público = public transport; medio de transporte = means of transport.
items.ex: Uso el transporte público para ir al trabajo.
items.exEn: I use public transport to get to work.

items.use: De bolsillo = pocket-sized. Pagar de su bolsillo = pay out of one's own pocket.
items.ex: Tengo las llaves en el bolsillo.
items.exEn: I have the keys in my pocket.

items.use: The verb is sonreír. Con una sonrisa = with a smile.
items.ex: Me saludó con una gran sonrisa.
items.exEn: She greeted me with a big smile.

items.use: For internet, flights and between people. Conexión a internet; perder la conexión.
items.ex: La conexión a internet está muy lenta.
items.exEn: The internet connection is really slow.

items.use: In Latin America plata is the everyday word for money, used without a plural: no tengo plata. Also the metal silver.
items.ex: No tengo plata para salir este fin de semana.
items.exEn: I don't have money to go out this weekend.
items.latam: Very common in Panama and Latin America for money. In Spain people say dinero or pasta.

items.use: Lenguaje is a style or system: lenguaje formal, lenguaje de señas. A national language like Spanish is idioma or lengua.
items.ex: Usa un lenguaje muy formal en sus correos.
items.exEn: He uses very formal language in his emails.

items.use: Sacar una copia = make a copy. Copia de seguridad = backup.
items.ex: Necesito dos copias de su cédula.
items.exEn: I need two copies of your ID card.

items.use: Fame and honor, or heaven in religious talk. Saber a gloria = to taste wonderful.
items.ex: Este café me supo a gloria.
items.exEn: This coffee tasted wonderful.

items.use: Also an adjective: una persona adulta. Adulto mayor = senior citizen.
items.ex: La entrada cuesta diez dólares para adultos.
items.exEn: Admission costs ten dollars for adults.

items.use: Tengo la impresión de que... = I have the feeling that... Also printing: la impresión del documento. Dar impresión = to be upsetting.
items.ex: Tengo la impresión de que no le gustó.
items.exEn: I get the feeling he didn't like it.

items.use: Hacer una promesa = make a promise; cumplir una promesa = keep a promise.
items.ex: Siempre cumple sus promesas.
items.exEn: She always keeps her promises.

items.use: The head of a province or state. Panama has provincial gobernadores appointed by the president.
items.ex: La gobernadora visitó la escuela nueva.
items.exEn: The governor visited the new school.

items.use: Means a coin, and also a country's currency. Bills are billetes.
items.ex: ¿Tienes monedas para el estacionamiento?
items.exEn: Do you have coins for the parking?
items.latam: Panama's currency is the balboa, used together with the US dollar.

items.use: The act of creating or a thing created. Creación de empleo = job creation.
items.ex: El gobierno prometió la creación de nuevos empleos.
items.exEn: The government promised to create new jobs.

items.use: Accent on the í. ¡Qué alegría! = How wonderful! Related adjective: alegre.
items.ex: ¡Qué alegría verte otra vez!
items.exEn: It's so great to see you again!

items.use: Someone who works for the government. Not 'functionary' in tone; it is a neutral, common word.
items.ex: Mi tía es funcionaria del Ministerio de Salud.
items.exEn: My aunt is a civil servant at the Ministry of Health.

items.use: A shirt with buttons and collar. A T-shirt is camiseta (or suéter in Panama).
items.ex: Me puse una camisa blanca para la entrevista.
items.exEn: I wore a white shirt for the interview.
items.latam: In Panama a T-shirt is often called un suéter.

items.use: Esquina is an outside corner, like a street corner: en la esquina. An inside corner of a room is el rincón.
items.ex: La farmacia está en la esquina.
items.exEn: The pharmacy is on the corner.

items.use: Meaning varies by country: cake, pie or a savory pastry. Also pastel colors: colores pastel.
items.ex: Le hicimos un pastel de chocolate para su cumpleaños.
items.exEn: We made him a chocolate cake for his birthday.
items.latam: In Panama a birthday cake is usually called un dulce or un cake; pastel is understood everywhere.

items.use: Always feminine, even for a male being. Also a tender word for a baby or small child.
items.ex: En la película aparece una criatura extraña.
items.exEn: A strange creature appears in the movie.

items.use: Tomar la temperatura = take someone's temperature. Tener temperatura can mean to have a fever.
items.ex: La temperatura hoy llega a 33 grados.
items.exEn: The temperature today reaches 33 degrees.

items.use: Hacer una apuesta = make a bet. The verb is apostar (apuesto). Also a strategic choice: una apuesta por la educación.
items.ex: Perdí la apuesta y tuve que pagar la cena.
items.exEn: I lost the bet and had to pay for dinner.

items.use: Mirarse en el espejo = look at yourself in the mirror. Espejo retrovisor = rear-view mirror.
items.ex: Se miró en el espejo antes de salir.
items.exEn: She looked in the mirror before leaving.

items.use: Common in economics and personal development: crecimiento económico, crecimiento personal.
items.ex: El país tuvo un crecimiento económico fuerte.
items.exEn: The country had strong economic growth.

items.use: Delivery of goods (entrega a domicilio), or handing in work (fecha de entrega = deadline). Also dedication.
items.ex: La fecha de entrega del proyecto es el viernes.
items.exEn: The project deadline is Friday.

items.use: Inteligencia artificial (IA) = artificial intelligence. Also spy services: servicios de inteligencia.
items.ex: La inteligencia artificial está cambiando muchos trabajos.
items.exEn: Artificial intelligence is changing many jobs.

items.use: Stress on the e: mu-SE-o. Ir al museo; museo de arte.
items.ex: El domingo fuimos al Museo de la Biodiversidad.
items.exEn: On Sunday we went to the Biodiversity Museum.

items.use: Months are lowercase in Spanish. Use en: en septiembre. Dates: el 15 de septiembre. Setiembre is also accepted.
items.ex: Las clases empiezan en septiembre.
items.exEn: Classes start in September.

items.use: Means worry, not 'preoccupation' in the sense of distraction. The verb is preocuparse por.
items.ex: Mi mayor preocupación es la salud de mi mamá.
items.exEn: My biggest worry is my mom's health.

items.use: A member of the national assembly or congress, not a 'deputy' assistant.
items.ex: Los diputados aprobaron la nueva ley.
items.exEn: The legislators passed the new law.
items.latam: In Panama diputados sit in the Asamblea Nacional.

items.use: Tone of voice (no me hables en ese tono), a ringtone (tono del celular) or a shade of color.
items.ex: No me hables en ese tono.
items.exEn: Don't talk to me in that tone.

items.use: A natural or social event: fenómeno natural. Informally, someone great at something: es un fenómeno.
items.ex: El Niño es un fenómeno que afecta el clima.
items.exEn: El Niño is a phenomenon that affects the climate.

items.use: Como por arte de magia = as if by magic. A magician is un mago; magic tricks are trucos de magia.
items.ex: El niño quedó fascinado con el show de magia.
items.exEn: The boy was fascinated by the magic show.

items.use: Con frecuencia = often. ¿Con qué frecuencia...? = How often...?
items.ex: ¿Con qué frecuencia vas al gimnasio?
items.exEn: How often do you go to the gym?

items.use: Means both the roof and the ceiling. Sin techo = homeless.
items.ex: Con la lluvia se mojó el techo de la casa.
items.exEn: The roof of the house got wet in the rain.

items.use: The stress moves in the plural: régimen, regímenes. A political regime, a set of rules, or a diet: estar a régimen.
items.ex: El país vivió bajo un régimen militar.
items.exEn: The country lived under a military regime.

items.use: Hacer una reserva = make a reservation. Also a nature reserve (reserva natural).
items.ex: Hice una reserva en el hotel para el sábado.
items.exEn: I made a reservation at the hotel for Saturday.
items.latam: Many Latin Americans also say reservación.

items.use: Feminine. In the plural, amistades can mean friends: tiene muchas amistades.
items.ex: Nuestra amistad empezó en la universidad.
items.exEn: Our friendship began at university.

items.use: La década de los noventa = the nineties. Stress on the first syllable: DÉ-ca-da.
items.ex: La ciudad cambió mucho en la última década.
items.exEn: The city changed a lot in the last decade.

items.use: Masculine. Cáncer de mama, cáncer de piel. Also the zodiac sign.
items.ex: Detectaron el cáncer a tiempo.
items.exEn: They detected the cancer in time.

items.use: In the plural it usually means income: ingresos mensuales. Singular often means admission: ingreso a la universidad.
items.ex: Sus ingresos no alcanzan para pagar el alquiler.
items.exEn: Her income isn't enough to pay the rent.

items.use: Political reform (reforma educativa) or home renovation work (hacer reformas en la casa).
items.ex: El gobierno propuso una reforma a la Caja de Seguro Social.
items.exEn: The government proposed a reform of the Social Security Fund.

items.use: Gender changes the meaning: la cura = the cure, el cura = the priest. The verb curar means to cure or heal.
items.ex: Todavía no hay cura para esa enfermedad.
items.exEn: There's still no cure for that disease.

items.use: Masculine. Queso blanco, queso amarillo. A cheese sandwich is un sándwich de queso.
items.ex: Quiero un emparedado de jamón y queso.
items.exEn: I want a ham and cheese sandwich.
items.latam: In Panama a sandwich is often called emparedado.

items.use: Por tradición = traditionally. Related adjective: tradicional.
items.ex: El Carnaval es una tradición muy fuerte en Panamá.
items.exEn: Carnival is a very strong tradition in Panama.

items.use: Hacer referencia a = refer to. Referencias = job references. Punto de referencia = landmark for directions.
items.ex: ¿Me puede dar un punto de referencia para llegar?
items.exEn: Can you give me a landmark to find the place?
items.latam: In Panama, addresses are often given by punto de referencia instead of street numbers.

items.use: De rodillas = on one's knees. Me duele la rodilla (use the article, not 'my', with body parts).
items.ex: Me duele la rodilla cuando corro.
items.exEn: My knee hurts when I run.

items.use: Gender trap: ends in -a but is masculine, el mapa (like el día, el problema).
items.ex: Busca la dirección en el mapa del celular.
items.exEn: Look up the address on the map on your phone.

items.use: Hacer gracia = to be funny to someone: me hace gracia. No tiene gracia = it's not funny. The plural gives gracias (thanks).
items.ex: Su chiste no me hizo ninguna gracia.
items.exEn: I didn't find his joke funny at all.

items.use: Participación en + noun. Also a share in a company: tener participación en una empresa.
items.ex: La participación de los padres es muy importante.
items.exEn: Parents' participation is very important.

items.use: A lesson in a book or a life lesson: aprender la lección, dar una lección. Private classes are usually clases.
items.ex: Aprendí la lección y ahora ahorro más.
items.exEn: I learned my lesson and now I save more.

items.use: Ir a un concierto. Watch the spelling: concierto has ie.
items.ex: Compramos entradas para el concierto de Rubén Blades.
items.exEn: We bought tickets for the Rubén Blades concert.

items.use: Trade in general (comercio internacional) or a local business or shop (los comercios del barrio).
items.ex: Los comercios cierran temprano los domingos.
items.exEn: Shops close early on Sundays.

items.use: Accent drops in other forms: campeona, campeones. Also friendly praise: ¡Eres un campeón!
items.ex: Panamá quedó campeón del torneo.
items.exEn: Panama won the tournament.

items.use: Lowercase. En octubre; el 31 de octubre.
items.ex: En octubre llueve muchísimo en Panamá.
items.exEn: In October it rains a lot in Panama.

items.use: Lago is a lake; a lagoon is laguna. El lago Gatún is part of the Panama Canal.
items.ex: Hicimos un paseo en bote por el lago Gatún.
items.exEn: We took a boat trip on Gatun Lake.

items.use: Mostly in the formula su señoría, used to address a judge in court. Formal and rare in daily life.
items.ex: Con todo respeto, su señoría, mi cliente es inocente.
items.exEn: With all due respect, Your Honor, my client is innocent.

items.use: De milagro = by a miracle, just barely. ¡Qué milagro! = What a surprise to see you!
items.ex: Llegamos al aeropuerto de milagro.
items.exEn: We barely made it to the airport.

items.use: A parcel by mail, a pack (paquete de galletas) or a deal (paquete turístico).
items.ex: Me llegó un paquete de Amazon.
items.exEn: A package from Amazon arrived for me.

items.use: Affectionate word for father. Can also be a casual or flirty way to address a man, so use it with care.
items.ex: Papi, ¿me llevas a la escuela?
items.exEn: Daddy, will you take me to school?
items.latam: In Panama and the Caribbean, papi is also a common friendly way to call a boy or a man.

items.use: Correo electrónico or just correo = email. Mandar un correo = send an email. Correos can be the post office.
items.ex: Te mando el documento por correo.
items.exEn: I'll send you the document by email.

items.use: Stress on the e before the a: es-tra-TE-gia. Estrategia de + noun.
items.ex: Necesitamos una nueva estrategia de ventas.
items.exEn: We need a new sales strategy.

items.use: Al instante = immediately. Un instante = just a moment. Close to momento.
items.ex: Espérame un instante, ya regreso.
items.exEn: Wait for me a moment, I'll be right back.

items.use: Lowercase. En diciembre; el 25 de diciembre.
items.ex: En diciembre empieza la temporada seca.
items.exEn: The dry season begins in December.

items.use: A part of a newspaper, store or document: la sección de deportes, la sección de frutas.
items.ex: Lo encuentras en la sección de limpieza.
items.exEn: You'll find it in the cleaning section.

items.use: Influencia en/sobre + noun. Tener influencias = to have connections.
items.ex: Las redes sociales tienen mucha influencia en los jóvenes.
items.exEn: Social media has a lot of influence on young people.

items.use: Lowercase. Don't mix up junio (June) and julio (July).
items.ex: Me caso en junio.
items.exEn: I'm getting married in June.

items.use: Lowercase. In poetry abriles means years of age: sus quince abriles.
items.ex: Mi cumpleaños es el 10 de abril.
items.exEn: My birthday is April 10.

items.use: Masculine even for a kind woman: ella es un ángel. Ángel de la guarda = guardian angel.
items.ex: Mi abuela es un ángel con todos.
items.exEn: My grandmother is an angel to everyone.

items.use: Masculine. Cooking oil and motor oil: aceite de oliva, cambiar el aceite del carro. Vinegar is vinagre.
items.ex: Fríe los patacones en aceite bien caliente.
items.exEn: Fry the patacones in very hot oil.

items.use: The verb is almorzar (almuerzo). De almuerzo = for lunch.
items.ex: ¿Qué hay de almuerzo hoy?
items.exEn: What's for lunch today?
items.latam: In Spain the main midday meal is usually la comida.

items.use: Formal or police-report style for 'a person'. Said of a man it can sound distant or negative.
items.ex: La policía detuvo a un individuo sospechoso.
items.exEn: The police arrested a suspicious individual.

items.use: Gender trap: feminine, la costumbre. Tener la costumbre de + infinitive. Como de costumbre = as usual.
items.ex: Tengo la costumbre de caminar después de cenar.
items.exEn: I'm in the habit of walking after dinner.

items.use: Rope, cord or an instrument string. Dar cuerda = to wind up (a toy or clock).
items.ex: La guitarra tiene seis cuerdas.
items.exEn: The guitar has six strings.

items.use: Lowercase. En enero; el primero de enero.
items.ex: En enero empieza la época de vacaciones escolares.
items.exEn: School vacation season starts in January.

items.use: Religious sin, also used jokingly for tasty food: este postre es un pecado.
items.ex: Este dulce de chocolate es un pecado.
items.exEn: This chocolate cake is sinful.

items.use: Feminine. A laptop is una laptop or una computadora portátil.
items.ex: Trabajo todo el día en la computadora.
items.exEn: I work on the computer all day.
items.latam: Spain says el ordenador; some countries say el computador.

items.use: An art show (exposición de arte), a class presentation (hacer una exposición), or exposure to sun or risk.
items.ex: Mañana tengo una exposición en la clase de historia.
items.exEn: Tomorrow I have a presentation in history class.

items.use: Prender un cigarrillo = light a cigarette. Informally also cigarro in many places.
items.ex: Dejó los cigarrillos hace dos años.
items.exEn: He quit cigarettes two years ago.

items.use: Dar risa = to make someone laugh: me da risa. Morirse de risa = die laughing.
items.ex: Nos morimos de risa con sus historias.
items.exEn: We died laughing at his stories.

items.use: A cup for hot drinks. A glass is vaso; a wine glass is copa. Also a measuring cup in recipes.
items.ex: ¿Quieres una taza de café?
items.exEn: Do you want a cup of coffee?

items.use: Member of a senate. Panama has no senate; its legislators are diputados.
items.ex: El senador votó en contra de la ley.
items.exEn: The senator voted against the law.

items.use: Estar de moda = to be in fashion; pasado de moda = out of fashion.
items.ex: Ese estilo está muy de moda este año.
items.exEn: That style is very fashionable this year.

items.use: Often a musical instrument: tocar un instrumento. Also a tool or means for something.
items.ex: ¿Tocas algún instrumento?
items.exEn: Do you play an instrument?

items.use: Masculine even for a woman: ella es un genio. Tener mal genio = to be bad-tempered.
items.ex: Mi jefe tiene muy mal genio en las mañanas.
items.exEn: My boss is very bad-tempered in the mornings.

items.use: Stress on the i: de-mo-cra-CI-a. Adjective: democrático.
items.ex: Votar es parte de la democracia.
items.exEn: Voting is part of democracy.

items.use: A storm with rain and lightning. Tormenta tropical = tropical storm. A hurricane is un huracán.
items.ex: Anoche cayó una tormenta muy fuerte.
items.exEn: There was a very strong storm last night.

items.use: Ser una tumba = to keep a secret. A cemetery is un cementerio.
items.ex: Llevamos flores a la tumba de mi abuelo.
items.exEn: We took flowers to my grandfather's grave.

items.use: The female is la loba. Lobo marino = sea lion.
items.ex: El lobo es el villano de muchos cuentos.
items.exEn: The wolf is the villain of many stories.

items.use: A symbol (signo de interrogación) or zodiac sign (¿de qué signo eres?). A road or shop sign is un letrero.
items.ex: ¿De qué signo eres?
items.exEn: What's your star sign?

items.use: From ganar (win). Also an adjective: el equipo ganador.
items.ex: La ganadora del concurso recibió un premio.
items.exEn: The winner of the contest got a prize.

items.use: Feminine. En la primera fase = in the first stage. Fases de la luna = phases of the moon.
items.ex: El proyecto está en su fase final.
items.exEn: The project is in its final stage.

items.use: Feminine (-dad). Can also mean a celebrity: una personalidad de la televisión.
items.ex: Tiene una personalidad muy alegre.
items.exEn: She has a very cheerful personality.

items.use: Car traffic (hay mucho tráfico) and illegal trade (tráfico de drogas).
items.ex: Hay mucho tráfico en la Transístmica.
items.exEn: There's a lot of traffic on the Transístmica.
items.latam: Also tranque in Panama: ¡Qué tranque! = What a traffic jam!

items.use: A commercial or ad (anuncio en la tele), or an official announcement. Poner un anuncio = place an ad.
items.ex: Vi un anuncio de trabajo en internet.
items.exEn: I saw a job ad online.

items.use: No tener alternativa = to have no choice. Alternativa a + noun.
items.ex: No nos quedó otra alternativa.
items.exEn: We had no other option.

items.use: A lot of money (costar una fortuna) or luck (por fortuna = luckily).
items.ex: Ese carro le costó una fortuna.
items.exEn: That car cost him a fortune.

items.use: A camp or campsite: campamento de verano. The activity is acampar.
items.ex: Los niños van a un campamento en las vacaciones.
items.exEn: The kids are going to a camp during the vacation.

items.use: Hacer un gesto = make a gesture. Un buen gesto = a kind gesture. Not 'gest' or 'jest'.
items.ex: Fue un gesto muy bonito de tu parte.
items.exEn: That was a very nice gesture of yours.

items.use: Military combat or a boxing match. Also a fight against something: el combate contra el dengue.
items.ex: El boxeador ganó el combate en el tercer asalto.
items.exEn: The boxer won the fight in the third round.

items.use: Treasure, and a loving term for a child or partner. El Tesoro can be the national treasury.
items.ex: Ese viejo álbum de fotos es un tesoro.
items.exEn: That old photo album is a treasure.

items.use: An old-fashioned word for boss, a pattern (patrón de comportamiento), or a patron saint (santo patrón).
items.ex: Hay un patrón en estos errores.
items.exEn: There's a pattern in these mistakes.

items.use: A unit of weight (about 454 g) or the British currency. Feminine: una libra.
items.ex: Deme una libra de queso, por favor.
items.exEn: Give me a pound of cheese, please.
items.latam: In Panama food is commonly sold by the pound, not the kilo.

items.use: An organized event: un evento deportivo. In formal writing acontecimiento is used for big happenings.
items.ex: La empresa organizó un evento para los clientes.
items.exEn: The company organized an event for clients.

items.use: A budget (tener poco presupuesto) or a price quote from a contractor (pedir un presupuesto).
items.ex: No tenemos presupuesto para un viaje este año.
items.exEn: We don't have a budget for a trip this year.
items.latam: For a work quote, Panamanians often say cotización.

items.use: False friend: fábrica means factory, not fabric. Fabric is tela.
items.ex: Mi papá trabajó años en una fábrica de zapatos.
items.exEn: My dad worked for years in a shoe factory.

items.use: A statistic or amount (las cifras de desempleo), or a digit: un número de tres cifras.
items.ex: Las cifras de turismo subieron este año.
items.exEn: Tourism figures rose this year.

items.use: A private office or study, often of a lawyer or official. Also the dispatching of goods.
items.ex: El abogado nos recibió en su despacho.
items.exEn: The lawyer saw us in his office.

items.use: Math division, a split between people, or a department of a company or a sports league.
items.ex: Hay mucha división dentro del partido.
items.exEn: There's a lot of division within the party.

items.use: Usually masculine (el azúcar), but feminine adjectives are also correct: azúcar morena. Sin azúcar = sugar-free.
items.ex: ¿Le pones azúcar al café?
items.exEn: Do you put sugar in your coffee?

items.use: An animal's tail, or a line of people: hacer cola. Also glue (cola de pegar).
items.ex: Tuvimos que hacer cola una hora en el banco.
items.exEn: We had to wait in line for an hour at the bank.
items.latam: In Panama hacer fila is more common for waiting in line.

items.use: Masculine noun; also an adjective meaning even or uniform. Uniforme escolar = school uniform.
items.ex: Todos los estudiantes llevan uniforme.
items.exEn: All the students wear a uniform.

items.use: Same form for both: el/la asistente. Also people present at an event (los asistentes). Asistente virtual = virtual assistant.
items.ex: Mi asistente te va a llamar mañana.
items.exEn: My assistant will call you tomorrow.

items.use: Spanish word order: ácido desoxirribonucleico, so ADN, not DNA. Said letter by letter: a-de-ene. Prueba de ADN = DNA test.
items.ex: La prueba de ADN confirmó la identidad.
items.exEn: The DNA test confirmed the identity.

items.use: Feminine. Plural changes z to c: raíces. A raíz de = as a result of. Echar raíces = put down roots.
items.ex: A raíz de la lluvia, se cancelaron las clases.
items.exEn: Because of the rain, classes were canceled.

items.use: Hacer un comentario = make a comment. Sin comentarios = no comment.
items.ex: Dejé un comentario en su foto.
items.exEn: I left a comment on her photo.

items.use: False friend: conductor means driver, not a train or orchestra conductor (director de orquesta). Also a TV or radio host.
items.ex: El conductor del bus manejaba muy rápido.
items.exEn: The bus driver was driving very fast.
items.latam: In Panama a bus driver is often called el chofer.

items.use: The far end of something (al otro extremo de la ciudad) or an extreme. Llegar al extremo de = go as far as.
items.ex: Vive en el otro extremo de la ciudad.
items.exEn: He lives at the other end of the city.

items.use: The verb is desayunar. De desayuno = for breakfast. Desayuno incluido = breakfast included.
items.ex: De desayuno comí hojaldre con huevo.
items.exEn: For breakfast I had fried dough with eggs.

items.use: A destructive fire: incendio forestal. A small fire or campfire is fuego or fogata.
items.ex: Los bomberos apagaron el incendio rápido.
items.exEn: The firefighters put out the fire quickly.

items.use: Same form in the plural. Use el martes (on Tuesday) and los martes (on Tuesdays), with no 'en'.
items.ex: Tengo clase de inglés los martes.
items.exEn: I have English class on Tuesdays.

items.use: A small boat (bote de motor) or a jar or can in some countries. Not related to boot (bota).
items.ex: Fuimos en bote hasta la isla.
items.exEn: We went to the island by boat.
items.latam: In Panama bote is the usual word for a small motorboat to the islands.

items.use: A tour by a band, team or politician: estar de gira. A guided visit is un tour or una visita guiada.
items.ex: La banda está de gira por Centroamérica.
items.exEn: The band is on tour in Central America.
items.latam: In Panama gira also means a school or work field trip.

items.use: Also used figuratively: ser esclavo del trabajo. Slavery is la esclavitud.
items.ex: No quiero ser esclavo del celular.
items.exEn: I don't want to be a slave to my phone.

items.use: Tener pasión por + noun. Strong love or enthusiasm. Semana Santa remembers la Pasión de Cristo.
items.ex: El fútbol es su gran pasión.
items.exEn: Soccer is his great passion.

items.use: Feminine. More formal than comportamiento: buena conducta, mala conducta.
items.ex: Lo suspendieron por mala conducta.
items.exEn: He was suspended for bad behavior.

items.use: Masculine. Corre el rumor de que... = there's a rumor that... Also a soft murmur.
items.ex: Corre el rumor de que van a cerrar la tienda.
items.exEn: There's a rumor they're going to close the store.

items.use: A route or path, also a bus line: la ruta del bus. En ruta = on the way.
items.ex: ¿Qué ruta tomas para llegar al trabajo?
items.exEn: What route do you take to get to work?

items.use: A phone app (also la app) or applying something. A job application is usually una solicitud.
items.ex: Descarga la aplicación del banco.
items.exEn: Download the bank's app.

items.use: Same form in the plural. El jueves = on Thursday; los jueves = on Thursdays.
items.ex: Nos vemos el jueves.
items.exEn: See you on Thursday.

items.use: ¡Qué lástima! = What a shame! Es una lástima que + subjunctive. Dar lástima = to make someone feel sorry.
items.ex: ¡Qué lástima que no puedas venir!
items.exEn: What a shame you can't come!

items.use: The everyday word for car in Panama and much of Latin America. Manejar un carro = drive a car. Carrito = shopping cart.
items.ex: Dejé el carro en el estacionamiento.
items.exEn: I left the car in the parking lot.
items.latam: Spain says el coche; Argentina and Chile say el auto.

items.use: A line of people (hacer fila) or a row of seats (en la primera fila).
items.ex: Hay que hacer fila para pagar.
items.exEn: You have to wait in line to pay.

items.use: The female is la vaca (cow). Agarrar el toro por los cuernos = take the bull by the horns.
items.ex: En la finca tienen un toro enorme.
items.exEn: They have a huge bull on the farm.

items.use: Glass in a window or fine glassware. For everyday glass material, vidrio is more common in Latin America.
items.ex: Se rompió el cristal de la ventana.
items.exEn: The window glass broke.
items.latam: In Latin America vidrio is the usual word; cristal often sounds finer or more Spain-like.

items.use: Key difference: pescado is fish as food; pez is the live fish in the water.
items.ex: En el Mercado de Mariscos venden pescado fresco.
items.exEn: They sell fresh fish at the Seafood Market.

items.use: Usually plural for soldiers: las tropas. Informally a big group of people.
items.ex: Las tropas llegaron a la frontera.
items.exEn: The troops reached the border.

items.use: Same form for both: el/la dirigente. Used for leaders of parties, unions or groups.
items.ex: Los dirigentes del sindicato pidieron una reunión.
items.exEn: The union leaders asked for a meeting.

items.use: A talk with slides, a show, or introducing people: hacer las presentaciones.
items.ex: Mañana tengo una presentación con el cliente.
items.exEn: Tomorrow I have a presentation with the client.

items.use: A mine for minerals or an explosive mine. Also the lead in a pencil. Mina de oro = gold mine.
items.ex: La mina de cobre genera mucho debate en Panamá.
items.exEn: The copper mine causes a lot of debate in Panama.

items.use: Legal and news word. In daily speech people say asesinato or crimen.
items.ex: La policía investiga el homicidio.
items.exEn: The police are investigating the homicide.

items.use: Singular often means installing something. Plural instalaciones = facilities: instalaciones deportivas.
items.ex: El hotel tiene muy buenas instalaciones.
items.exEn: The hotel has very good facilities.

items.use: Tener una pesadilla = have a nightmare. Also a terrible situation: el tráfico es una pesadilla.
items.ex: Anoche tuve una pesadilla horrible.
items.exEn: Last night I had a horrible nightmare.

items.use: A shape, or a group of people: círculo de amigos. Círculo vicioso = vicious circle.
items.ex: Los niños se sentaron en círculo.
items.exEn: The children sat in a circle.

items.use: All people, or human kindness. Las humanidades = the humanities (school subjects).
items.ex: Fue un gran avance para la humanidad.
items.exEn: It was a great step forward for humanity.

items.use: Lowercase. En marzo; el 8 de marzo.
items.ex: El año escolar en Panamá empieza en marzo.
items.exEn: The school year in Panama starts in March.

items.use: Masculine. Un chocolate can be a candy or a cup of hot chocolate. Helado de chocolate = chocolate ice cream.
items.ex: Me encanta el helado de chocolate.
items.exEn: I love chocolate ice cream.

items.use: Gender trap: feminine, but el ala in the singular because it starts with stressed a. Plural: las alas.
items.ex: El pájaro tiene un ala lastimada.
items.exEn: The bird has an injured wing.

items.use: Same form for both: el/la adolescente. More informal: chico, chica, or pelado in Panama.
items.ex: Tengo dos hijos adolescentes.
items.exEn: I have two teenage children.

items.use: La Virgen = the Virgin Mary. Plural gets an accent: vírgenes. Also an adjective: aceite de oliva virgen, selva virgen.
items.ex: Muchos pueblos celebran la fiesta de la Virgen.
items.exEn: Many towns celebrate the feast of the Virgin.

items.use: Oso de peluche = teddy bear. Oso perezoso = sloth, which you can see in Panama.
items.ex: Vimos un oso perezoso en el parque.
items.exEn: We saw a sloth in the park.

items.use: Oreja is the outer ear. The inner ear and the sense of hearing is el oído: me duele el oído = I have an earache.
items.ex: Se puso aretes en las orejas.
items.exEn: She put earrings in her ears.

items.use: Tension between people or stress. Tensión arterial = blood pressure. Also electrical voltage.
items.ex: Había mucha tensión en la reunión.
items.exEn: There was a lot of tension in the meeting.
items.latam: For blood pressure Panamanians usually say la presión.

items.use: Hacer la maleta = pack your suitcase. A briefcase is un maletín.
items.ex: Todavía no he hecho la maleta.
items.exEn: I still haven't packed my suitcase.

items.use: Often plural: las negociaciones. The verb is negociar.
items.ex: Las negociaciones duraron toda la noche.
items.exEn: The negotiations lasted all night.

items.use: Legs of animals and furniture. For people it is informal. Meter la pata = put your foot in it. Patas arriba = upside down, a mess.
items.ex: Metí la pata con lo que le dije.
items.exEn: I put my foot in it with what I said.

items.use: The tip of something: la punta del lápiz. Hora punta (Spain) / hora pico (LatAm) = rush hour. De punta a punta = end to end.
items.ex: Lo tengo en la punta de la lengua.
items.exEn: It's on the tip of my tongue.

items.use: Lowercase. En noviembre; el 3 de noviembre.
items.ex: En noviembre se celebran las fiestas patrias.
items.exEn: The national holidays are celebrated in November.

items.use: Also a sudden burst: explosión de alegría. The verb is explotar.
items.ex: Escuchamos una explosión cerca del puerto.
items.exEn: We heard an explosion near the port.

items.use: En invierno = in winter. Seasons are lowercase.
items.ex: En invierno llueve casi todas las tardes.
items.exEn: In the rainy season it rains almost every afternoon.
items.latam: In Panama and Central America, invierno often means the rainy season, and verano the dry season.

items.use: Diseño gráfico, diseño de interiores. The person is un diseñador or una diseñadora.
items.ex: Me gusta el diseño de tu página web.
items.exEn: I like the design of your website.

items.use: Ends in -a but el poeta for a man. For a woman both la poeta and la poetisa are used.
items.ex: Ricardo Miró es un poeta panameño muy famoso.
items.exEn: Ricardo Miró is a very famous Panamanian poet.

items.use: Usually means a heated argument, not just a calm talk. Tener una discusión = to have a fight. Plural loses the accent: discusiones.
items.ex: Anoche tuve una discusión con mi hermano.
items.exEn: Last night I had an argument with my brother.

items.use: Poner excusas = to make excuses. No hay excusa = there's no excuse.
items.ex: Siempre pone excusas para no venir.
items.exEn: He always makes excuses not to come.

items.use: Only a living cell or a secret group. A prison cell is celda, and a cellphone is celular.
items.ex: El cuerpo humano tiene millones de células.
items.exEn: The human body has millions of cells.

items.use: Llegar a una conclusión = to reach a conclusion. En conclusión = in conclusion (useful in DELE essays).
items.ex: Llegamos a la conclusión de que era mejor esperar.
items.exEn: We came to the conclusion that it was better to wait.

items.use: For films, music or farming. La productora can also mean the production company.
items.ex: Los productores de café esperan un buen año.
items.exEn: Coffee producers are hoping for a good year.

items.use: Always feminine, even for a male rat. Ser una rata = to be a cheat or a stingy person (informal insult).
items.ex: Vimos una rata cerca de la basura.
items.exEn: We saw a rat near the garbage.
items.latam: In Panama, rata is also slang for a thief.

items.use: A corridor in a building, or an aisle in a store or plane. Asiento de pasillo = aisle seat.
items.ex: El baño está al final del pasillo.
items.exEn: The bathroom is at the end of the hallway.

items.use: False friend: lectura is reading, not a lecture. A lecture is una conferencia or una clase. Comprensión de lectura = reading comprehension (a DELE task).
items.ex: La lectura es mi pasatiempo favorito.
items.exEn: Reading is my favorite hobby.

items.use: Means bad luck or a tragedy, not mainly a disgrace. Por desgracia = unfortunately.
items.ex: Por desgracia, perdimos el vuelo.
items.exEn: Unfortunately, we missed the flight.

items.use: La oposición = the parties not in government. En oposición a = in opposition to.
items.ex: La oposición votó en contra de la ley.
items.exEn: The opposition voted against the law.
items.latam: In Spain, oposiciones are exams for government jobs; this use is rare in Panama.

items.use: A fall from a height, a drop in prices, or a system crash. Caída del pelo = hair loss.
items.ex: Sufrió una caída en la escalera.
items.exEn: She had a fall on the stairs.

items.use: Una partida de ajedrez/cartas = a game of chess/cards. A football game is un partido (masculine). Also formal for departure; partida de nacimiento = birth certificate.
items.ex: ¿Jugamos una partida de dominó?
items.exEn: Shall we play a game of dominoes?

items.use: A written essay, a rehearsal for a play or concert, or a scientific trial. Ensayo clínico = clinical trial.
items.ex: Tengo que escribir un ensayo para el lunes.
items.exEn: I have to write an essay for Monday.

items.use: Mostly in fixed phrases: puesta de sol = sunset, puesta en marcha = launch/start-up, puesta en escena = staging.
items.ex: Fuimos a la playa a ver la puesta de sol.
items.exEn: We went to the beach to watch the sunset.

items.use: Two meanings: the wrist, and a doll. A boy doll or stuffed toy is un muñeco.
items.ex: Me torcí la muñeca jugando tenis.
items.exEn: I sprained my wrist playing tennis.

items.use: The female is la gallina (hen). Pelea de gallos = cockfight.
items.ex: El gallo canta todas las mañanas a las cinco.
items.exEn: The rooster crows every morning at five.

items.use: Por venganza = out of revenge. The verb is vengarse de alguien.
items.ex: Lo hizo por venganza.
items.exEn: He did it out of revenge.

items.use: An episode of a series, or an event in someone's life. Also capítulo for TV episodes.
items.ex: Anoche vi tres episodios seguidos.
items.exEn: Last night I watched three episodes in a row.

items.use: Sports or job training. The verb is entrenar.
items.ex: El entrenamiento empieza a las seis.
items.exEn: Training starts at six.

items.use: Use of energy, food, products. Consumo de agua/luz = water/electricity use. Not the illness (that is tuberculosis).
items.ex: El consumo de luz sube mucho con el aire acondicionado.
items.exEn: Electricity use goes way up with the air conditioning.

items.use: Novela de misterio = mystery novel. Adjective: misterioso.
items.ex: Para mí sigue siendo un misterio.
items.exEn: To me it's still a mystery.

items.use: Screen of a phone, TV, computer or cinema. Pantalla grande = the big screen (cinema).
items.ex: Se me rompió la pantalla del celular.
items.exEn: My phone screen broke.

items.use: Usually a private medical center. Clínica dental = dental clinic.
items.ex: Lo llevaron a una clínica privada.
items.exEn: They took him to a private clinic.

items.use: Mostly plural: las instrucciones = the directions. Seguir las instrucciones = follow the instructions.
items.ex: Lee bien las instrucciones antes de empezar.
items.exEn: Read the instructions carefully before you start.

items.use: Opposite of salida. At airports: Llegadas = Arrivals. A su llegada = on arrival.
items.ex: La llegada del vuelo está prevista para las ocho.
items.exEn: The flight's arrival is scheduled for eight.

items.use: In Latin America it mainly means a banknote. For a ticket, Latin Americans say boleto or pasaje.
items.ex: ¿Tienes cambio de un billete de veinte?
items.exEn: Do you have change for a twenty-dollar bill?
items.latam: In Spain, billete is also a train/plane ticket; in Panama say boleto or pasaje.

items.use: Months are lowercase in Spanish. En agosto = in August. Hacer su agosto = to make a lot of money fast.
items.ex: Mi cumpleaños es el 15 de agosto.
items.exEn: My birthday is August 15th.

items.use: Dolor de estómago = stomachache. Note the accent: es-TÓ-ma-go.
items.ex: Me duele el estómago.
items.exEn: My stomach hurts.

items.use: Estar a (tu) disposición = to be at your service. Also a legal rule or regulation.
items.ex: Estoy a su disposición para cualquier pregunta.
items.exEn: I'm at your disposal for any questions.

items.use: Panama is divided into provinces (provincias) and comarcas. En el interior = in the provinces outside the capital.
items.ex: Ella es de la provincia de Chiriquí.
items.exEn: She's from the province of Chiriquí.

items.use: A political or business alliance. Can also mean a wedding band, though anillo de boda is more common.
items.ex: Los dos partidos formaron una alianza.
items.exEn: The two parties formed an alliance.

items.use: Short for kilogramo. Un kilo de arroz. Subir/bajar de kilos = to gain/lose weight.
items.ex: Compré dos kilos de arroz.
items.exEn: I bought two kilos of rice.
items.latam: In Panama many people still use libras (pounds) at the market.

items.use: A senior police officer, or a commissioner (e.g. comisario europeo). Don't confuse with comisaría (police station).
items.ex: El comisario habló con la prensa.
items.exEn: The police inspector spoke to the press.

items.use: Fruit, and also a city block. The tree is el manzano.
items.ex: Me como una manzana todos los días.
items.exEn: I eat an apple every day.
items.latam: For a city block, Panama often says cuadra.

items.use: Any machine or gadget. Aparatos eléctricos = electrical appliances. Also dental braces.
items.ex: Este aparato no funciona.
items.exEn: This device doesn't work.

items.use: Feminine: la nieve. Muñeco de nieve = snowman. Verb: nevar.
items.ex: Nunca he visto la nieve.
items.exEn: I've never seen snow.
items.latam: In some countries (e.g. Mexico) nieve also means sorbet or ice cream.

items.use: Singular is criterio, plural criterios (not criteria). Tener buen criterio = to have good judgment.
items.ex: Confío en tu criterio.
items.exEn: I trust your judgment.

items.use: Pagar con cheque = to pay by check. Cobrar un cheque = to cash a check. Not a restaurant check (that is la cuenta).
items.ex: Me pagaron con un cheque.
items.exEn: They paid me with a check.

items.use: Feminine: la nube. Estar en las nubes = to be daydreaming. Guardar en la nube = save in the cloud.
items.ex: Hoy hay muchas nubes; va a llover.
items.exEn: It's very cloudy today; it's going to rain.

items.use: Sin dejar rastro = without a trace. Seguir el rastro = to follow the trail.
items.ex: Desapareció sin dejar rastro.
items.exEn: He disappeared without a trace.

items.use: Masculine: el debate. Debate presidencial = presidential debate.
items.ex: Vimos el debate entre los candidatos.
items.exEn: We watched the debate between the candidates.

items.use: Also means a medical operation (intervención quirúrgica) or a person's turn to speak at a meeting.
items.ex: Su intervención en la reunión fue muy clara.
items.exEn: His contribution at the meeting was very clear.

items.use: Masculine: el cable. Televisión por cable = cable TV. Echar un cable = to give a hand (Spain).
items.ex: Necesito un cable para cargar el celular.
items.exEn: I need a cable to charge my phone.

items.use: An administrative area. Panama's provinces are split into distritos and corregimientos.
items.ex: Vivo en el distrito de San Miguelito.
items.exEn: I live in the district of San Miguelito.

items.use: The animal. As meat, people usually say res or carne de res. Hacer una vaca = to pool money.
items.ex: En la finca de mi abuelo hay vacas.
items.exEn: There are cows on my grandfather's farm.

items.use: Someone who owns or runs a business. Also emprendedor for a start-up founder.
items.ex: Su papá es un empresario muy conocido.
items.exEn: Her dad is a well-known businessman.

items.use: Grass, or herbs for cooking and tea (hierbas aromáticas). Also spelled yerba. Mala hierba = weed.
items.ex: Los niños jugaban en la hierba.
items.exEn: The kids were playing on the grass.
items.latam: In Panama, grass is usually grama or césped; hierba is more for herbs.

items.use: Tener tendencia a + infinitive = to tend to. Ser tendencia = to be trending.
items.ex: Tiene tendencia a llegar tarde.
items.exEn: He tends to arrive late.

items.use: Mis sobrinos can mean nephews only, or nephews and nieces together.
items.ex: Mi sobrina cumple diez años mañana.
items.exEn: My niece turns ten tomorrow.

items.use: False friend: mainly sand. A sports arena is usually estadio or coliseo.
items.ex: La arena de esta playa es muy blanca.
items.exEn: The sand on this beach is very white.

items.use: Masculine, and the plural is the same: el virus, los virus. Also a computer virus.
items.ex: Mi computadora tiene un virus.
items.exEn: My computer has a virus.

items.use: Without an accent, it is the formal medical word: cáncer de mama = breast cancer. Mom is mamá, with an accent.
items.ex: Octubre es el mes contra el cáncer de mama.
items.exEn: October is breast cancer awareness month.

items.use: Cirugía plástica/estética = cosmetic surgery. Also operación.
items.ex: Necesita una cirugía de rodilla.
items.exEn: He needs knee surgery.

items.use: El/la guarda for a person. Guardia is more common for police or security guards.
items.ex: El guarda del edificio nos abrió la puerta.
items.exEn: The building guard opened the door for us.
items.latam: In Panama, a security guard is usually un seguridad or un guardia.

items.use: Stronger and more formal than enojo or rabia. Ataque de ira = fit of rage.
items.ex: No pudo controlar su ira.
items.exEn: He couldn't control his rage.

items.use: A thick or outside wall, like a city wall. An inside wall of a room is pared. Also a Facebook wall.
items.ex: Construyeron un muro alrededor de la casa.
items.exEn: They built a wall around the house.

items.use: Desde mi perspectiva = from my point of view. Perspectivas (pl.) = prospects.
items.ex: Desde esa perspectiva, tienes razón.
items.exEn: From that perspective, you're right.

items.use: An edition of a book, newspaper or event. Also video/photo editing.
items.ex: Esta es la quinta edición del festival.
items.exEn: This is the fifth edition of the festival.

items.use: A workers' union. Not a crime syndicate in normal use.
items.ex: El sindicato convocó una huelga.
items.exEn: The union called a strike.

items.use: Formal word. In everyday speech, a Catholic priest is usually el padre or el cura.
items.ex: El sacerdote celebró la misa.
items.exEn: The priest said Mass.

items.use: Informal. Meterse en un lío = to get into trouble. ¡Qué lío! = What a mess!
items.ex: Me metí en un lío por llegar tarde.
items.exEn: I got into trouble for being late.

items.use: Body organs, the musical instrument, or an official body. Donación de órganos = organ donation.
items.ex: El corazón es un órgano vital.
items.exEn: The heart is a vital organ.

items.use: Physical stamina, opposition, or an electrical resistor.
items.ex: Correr mejora la resistencia.
items.exEn: Running improves stamina.

items.use: Dibujos animados or caricaturas = cartoons. The verb is dibujar.
items.ex: Mi hija me hizo un dibujo.
items.exEn: My daughter made me a drawing.

items.use: Book cover, ship deck (en cubierta = on deck), or a covering.
items.ex: Subimos a la cubierta del barco.
items.exEn: We went up to the ship's deck.

items.use: Al alcance de = within reach of. Fuera del alcance de los niños = keep out of reach of children.
items.ex: Mantener fuera del alcance de los niños.
items.exEn: Keep out of reach of children.

items.use: Mis nietos = my grandchildren (boys and girls together).
items.ex: Mi abuela tiene ocho nietos.
items.exEn: My grandmother has eight grandchildren.

items.use: Masculine: el funeral. Also used: el velorio (the wake) and el entierro (the burial).
items.ex: Fuimos al funeral de su abuelo.
items.exEn: We went to his grandfather's funeral.

items.use: Pronounced roughly 'GÜIS-ki'. Also spelled güisqui.
items.ex: Pidió un whisky con hielo.
items.exEn: He ordered a whisky on the rocks.

items.use: La bandera de Panamá. Izar la bandera = to raise the flag.
items.ex: En noviembre ponen banderas en todas las casas.
items.exEn: In November they put flags on every house.

items.use: Affectionate, informal word for mom. Avoid using it with strange women: it sounds like a catcall.
items.ex: Mami, ¿me ayudas con la tarea?
items.exEn: Mom, can you help me with my homework?
items.latam: Very common in Panama and the Caribbean, also as a pet name for a girlfriend or daughter.

items.use: Not a diversion in English sense. Por diversión = for fun. Parque de diversiones = amusement park.
items.ex: Lo hago solo por diversión.
items.exEn: I only do it for fun.

items.use: The yard of a house, or a school playground (patio de recreo).
items.ex: Los niños están jugando en el patio.
items.exEn: The kids are playing in the yard.

items.use: A scientist doing research, or a detective. Investigación = research or investigation.
items.ex: Los investigadores descubrieron una nueva especie.
items.exEn: The researchers discovered a new species.

items.use: La selección = the national sports team. Proceso de selección = hiring process.
items.ex: La selección de Panamá juega esta noche.
items.exEn: Panama's national team plays tonight.

items.use: Feminine: una milla. Millas de viajero frecuente = frequent flyer miles.
items.ex: Corrí tres millas esta mañana.
items.exEn: I ran three miles this morning.

items.use: A friendly chat, or an informal lecture (dar una charla). Verb: charlar.
items.ex: Dio una charla sobre salud en la escuela.
items.exEn: She gave a talk on health at the school.

items.use: Hora de cierre = closing time. In much of Latin America also a zipper.
items.ex: El cierre de la tienda es a las nueve.
items.exEn: The store closes at nine.
items.latam: For zipper, Panama often says zíper; Spain says cremallera.

items.use: A contest or competition. Concurso de belleza = beauty pageant. Not a concourse.
items.ex: Ganó un concurso de canto.
items.exEn: She won a singing contest.

items.use: A Spain word for the local government. You may see it in DELE texts.
items.ex: El ayuntamiento cerró la calle por obras.
items.exEn: The city council closed the street for roadwork.
items.latam: In Panama say la alcaldía or el municipio.

items.use: Formal. Entidad bancaria = bank. Words ending in -dad are feminine.
items.ex: Es una entidad sin fines de lucro.
items.exEn: It's a non-profit organization.

items.use: On clothes or machines. Pulsar/apretar el botón = press the button. Plural loses the accent: botones.
items.ex: Aprieta el botón rojo para apagarlo.
items.exEn: Press the red button to turn it off.

items.use: Lowercase, masculine, same form in plural. El miércoles = on Wednesday; los miércoles = on Wednesdays.
items.ex: Tengo clase de inglés los miércoles.
items.exEn: I have English class on Wednesdays.

items.use: False friend: a library is biblioteca; a bookstore is librería.
items.ex: Voy a estudiar en la biblioteca.
items.exEn: I'm going to study at the library.

items.use: Feminine. Plural loses the accent: religiones.
items.ex: Respeto todas las religiones.
items.exEn: I respect all religions.

items.use: Only used in Spain. Recognize it in DELE texts, but say computadora in Panama.
items.ex: Trabajo con el ordenador todo el día.
items.exEn: I work on the computer all day.
items.latam: Latin America says la computadora (or el computador in some countries).

items.use: Sin un centavo = broke. In Panama, centavos of the balboa/dollar.
items.ex: Cuesta un dólar con cincuenta centavos.
items.exEn: It costs a dollar fifty.

items.use: Only tears from the eyes. A tear in paper is una rotura. Con lágrimas en los ojos = with tears in her eyes.
items.ex: Se le salieron las lágrimas.
items.exEn: Tears came to her eyes.

items.use: Granja usually means an animal farm. Granja de pollos = chicken farm.
items.ex: Los niños visitaron una granja.
items.exEn: The kids visited a farm.
items.latam: In Panama, a farm or country property is usually una finca.

items.use: Masculine. Sin incidentes = without incident.
items.ex: El viaje terminó sin incidentes.
items.exEn: The trip ended without incident.

items.use: Jornada laboral = working day. Jornada completa / media jornada = full-time / part-time. Jornadas = conference days.
items.ex: Trabajo a jornada completa.
items.exEn: I work full time.

items.use: Almost only in a bordo = on board and tarjeta de embarque. Don't confuse with borde (edge).
items.ex: Ya estamos a bordo del avión.
items.exEn: We're already on board the plane.

items.use: Licencia de conducir = driver's license. Licencia de maternidad = maternity leave.
items.ex: Saqué la licencia de conducir el año pasado.
items.exEn: I got my driver's license last year.
items.latam: Spain says el carné de conducir.

items.use: A heavy coat. Ropa de abrigo = warm clothing. Al abrigo de = sheltered from.
items.ex: Lleva un abrigo; en Nueva York hace frío.
items.exEn: Take a coat; it's cold in New York.

items.use: Gender trap: masculine even though it ends in -a (el síntoma), like el problema.
items.ex: ¿Qué síntomas tiene?
items.exEn: What symptoms do you have?

items.use: Parada de bus = bus stop. Also a stop on a trip or a parade.
items.ex: Me bajo en la próxima parada.
items.exEn: I'm getting off at the next stop.

items.use: A handbag or shoulder bag. A plastic bag is una bolsa (feminine).
items.ex: Dejé las llaves en el bolso.
items.exEn: I left the keys in my purse.
items.latam: Also called cartera in Panama and many LatAm countries.

items.use: In Latin America, a car's license plate. Also a police badge, a plaque, or an X-ray.
items.ex: Anoté el número de placa del carro.
items.exEn: I wrote down the car's license plate number.
items.latam: Spain says la matrícula for a license plate.

items.use: Fecha de nacimiento = date of birth. At Christmas, el nacimiento is the nativity scene.
items.ex: Escriba su fecha de nacimiento.
items.exEn: Write your date of birth.

items.use: Any sauce, not only spicy dip. Salsa de tomate = ketchup or tomato sauce. Also the dance.
items.ex: ¿Le pones salsa picante a la comida?
items.exEn: Do you put hot sauce on your food?

items.use: Also a patient's progress: la evolución del paciente.
items.ex: El médico está contento con su evolución.
items.exEn: The doctor is happy with his progress.

items.use: ¡Ánimo! = Cheer up! / Go for it! Estado de ánimo = mood. No tener ánimo para = not be in the mood to.
items.ex: ¡Ánimo, que ya casi terminas!
items.exEn: Keep going, you're almost done!

items.use: Any place of worship, including churches. Masculine.
items.ex: Visitamos un templo budista.
items.exEn: We visited a Buddhist temple.

items.use: Formal. In daily speech, people say dueño/dueña.
items.ex: El propietario del apartamento subió el alquiler.
items.exEn: The apartment owner raised the rent.

items.use: Also the prosecution in court. Verb: acusar a alguien de algo.
items.ex: Él niega todas las acusaciones.
items.exEn: He denies all the accusations.

items.use: Any large car: SUV, pickup or van. Smaller than a camión (truck).
items.ex: Compraron una camioneta para la familia.
items.exEn: They bought an SUV for the family.

items.use: A candle, or a boat's sail. Pasar la noche en vela = to stay up all night. Barco de vela = sailboat.
items.ex: Sopla las velas del pastel.
items.exEn: Blow out the candles on the cake.

items.use: Irregular feminine: emperatriz (empress).
items.ex: Napoleón fue emperador de Francia.
items.exEn: Napoleon was emperor of France.

items.use: Tener curiosidad por = to be curious about. Por curiosidad = out of curiosity.
items.ex: Por curiosidad, ¿cuánto te costó?
items.exEn: Out of curiosity, how much did it cost you?

items.use: La caza = hunting. Ir de caza = to go hunting. El caza (masc.) is a fighter jet.
items.ex: La caza de esta especie está prohibida.
items.exEn: Hunting this species is banned.

items.use: En representación de = on behalf of. Also a theater performance.
items.ex: Vino en representación de la empresa.
items.exEn: He came on behalf of the company.

items.use: Complejo turístico/deportivo = resort/sports complex. Tener complejo de = to have a complex about.
items.ex: Se hospedaron en un complejo turístico en la playa.
items.exEn: They stayed at a beach resort.

items.use: Often means an ID card. Documento de identificación = ID document.
items.ex: Necesito ver su identificación, por favor.
items.exEn: I need to see your ID, please.
items.latam: In Panama, the national ID card is la cédula.

items.use: A request, formal or not. A petición de = at the request of. Pedido is more for orders.
items.ex: Atendieron mi petición enseguida.
items.exEn: They dealt with my request right away.

items.use: The time of being young, or young people as a group: la juventud de hoy.
items.ex: En mi juventud jugaba béisbol.
items.exEn: In my youth I played baseball.

items.use: ¡Qué coincidencia! = What a coincidence! Also an agreement of opinions.
items.ex: ¡Qué coincidencia verte aquí!
items.exEn: What a coincidence to see you here!

items.use: Cámaras de vigilancia = security cameras. Bajo vigilancia = under surveillance.
items.ex: El edificio tiene vigilancia las 24 horas.
items.exEn: The building has 24-hour security.

items.use: Noun: el desierto. As an adjective, desierto/a = deserted (una calle desierta). Dessert is postre.
items.ex: El desierto de Atacama está en Chile.
items.exEn: The Atacama Desert is in Chile.

items.use: Feminine: la torre. Also a high-rise building or the rook in chess.
items.ex: Vivimos en una torre de cuarenta pisos.
items.exEn: We live in a forty-story tower.

items.use: Usually uncountable: hay mucha publicidad. One ad is un anuncio.
items.ex: Trabaja en publicidad.
items.exEn: She works in advertising.

items.use: A big sack (saco de arroz). In much of Latin America also a suit jacket. Saco de dormir = sleeping bag.
items.ex: Ponte el saco, que la reunión es formal.
items.exEn: Put on your jacket; the meeting is formal.
items.latam: Spain says americana or chaqueta for a suit jacket.

items.use: Gestión empresarial = business management. Hacer unas gestiones = to run some errands / do paperwork.
items.ex: Tengo que hacer unas gestiones en el banco.
items.exEn: I have to take care of some things at the bank.

items.use: Sound volume, space, or a book. Note the plural gains an accent: volúmenes.
items.ex: ¿Puedes bajar el volumen?
items.exEn: Can you turn the volume down?

items.use: Always feminine, even for a man: es una bestia = he's a brute. Can also mean someone amazing at something.
items.ex: La bella y la bestia es mi película favorita.
items.exEn: Beauty and the Beast is my favorite movie.

items.use: El/la guía = the tour guide (person). La guía = the guidebook or a guide document.
items.ex: La guía nos explicó la historia del Casco Viejo.
items.exEn: The guide explained the history of Casco Viejo to us.

items.use: A board or plank, or a chart. Tabla de surf = surfboard. A dining table is mesa.
items.ex: Mira los datos en la tabla.
items.exEn: Look at the data in the table.

items.use: Masculine. Detector de humo = smoke detector. Echar humo = to fume (be very angry).
items.ex: Sale humo de la cocina.
items.exEn: There's smoke coming from the kitchen.

items.use: Feminine: la labor. Formal word for work or a task. Not childbirth labor (that is parto).
items.ex: Agradecemos su labor en la comunidad.
items.exEn: We appreciate your work in the community.

items.use: A jail cell, or a cell in a spreadsheet. A biological cell is célula.
items.ex: Pasó la noche en una celda.
items.exEn: He spent the night in a cell.

items.use: Feminine. Poner la alarma = to set the alarm. Alarma de incendios = fire alarm.
items.ex: Puse la alarma a las seis.
items.exEn: I set the alarm for six.

items.use: Mostly in a continuación = next, below, following. Very useful in writing.
items.ex: A continuación, les presento al director.
items.exEn: Next, I'll introduce the director to you.

items.use: Sin previo aviso = without warning. Hasta nuevo aviso = until further notice. Verb: avisar.
items.ex: Cerraron la tienda sin previo aviso.
items.exEn: They closed the store without warning.
items.latam: In Panama, aviso is also a sign or an ad (aviso clasificado).

items.use: Ceremonia de graduación/boda. Sin ceremonias = without fuss.
items.ex: La ceremonia empieza a las cuatro.
items.exEn: The ceremony starts at four.

items.use: ¿Cuál es el significado de...? = What's the meaning of...? Verb: significar.
items.ex: No sé el significado de esta palabra.
items.exEn: I don't know the meaning of this word.

items.use: En ausencia de = in the absence of. Opposite: presencia.
items.ex: Notamos su ausencia en la reunión.
items.exEn: We noticed his absence at the meeting.

items.use: A jacket. In Panama, chaqueta or suéter are common for light jackets.
items.ex: Lleva una chaqueta, que el aire está fuerte.
items.exEn: Bring a jacket; the A/C is strong.
items.latam: Careful in Mexico: chaqueta is also vulgar slang there. Chamarra is safer in Mexico.

items.use: Tomar la iniciativa = to take the initiative. Tener iniciativa = to be proactive.
items.ex: Ella siempre toma la iniciativa.
items.exEn: She always takes the initiative.

items.use: Gender trap: el ave but las aves (feminine; el is used before stressed a-). Pájaro is more common for small birds.
items.ex: Panamá tiene casi mil especies de aves.
items.exEn: Panama has almost a thousand bird species.

items.use: Verb: traducir (al/del español). Traducción simultánea = simultaneous interpretation.
items.ex: Necesito una traducción de este documento.
items.exEn: I need a translation of this document.

items.use: Mostly in the phrase en torno a = about, around (formal). Also a lathe or a turnstile.
items.ex: La charla giró en torno a la educación.
items.exEn: The talk revolved around education.

items.use: Tener la obligación de + infinitive = to be obliged to. Por obligación = out of obligation.
items.ex: Votar es un derecho y una obligación.
items.exEn: Voting is a right and a duty.

items.use: More formal than miedo. Por temor a = for fear of. Followed by subjunctive: temor a que + subj.
items.ex: No dijo nada por temor a perder su trabajo.
items.exEn: He said nothing for fear of losing his job.

items.use: Hacer progresos = to make progress (often plural in Spanish).
items.ex: Has hecho muchos progresos en español.
items.exEn: You've made a lot of progress in Spanish.

items.use: Estar castigado = to be grounded. Verb: castigar. Not to chastise.
items.ex: Como castigo, no puede usar el celular.
items.exEn: As punishment, he can't use his phone.

items.use: Gender trap: masculine despite -a (el clima). In Latin America it is also used for today's weather.
items.ex: El clima en Boquete es fresco.
items.exEn: The climate in Boquete is cool.
items.latam: Spain prefers el tiempo for daily weather; Latin America often says el clima.

items.use: A win in sports, politics or life. Verb: triunfar = to succeed.
items.ex: El equipo celebró el triunfo en la calle.
items.exEn: The team celebrated the victory in the street.

items.use: ¡Qué maravilla! = How wonderful! De maravilla = wonderfully. Las siete maravillas = the seven wonders.
items.ex: La comida estuvo de maravilla.
items.exEn: The food was wonderful.

items.use: Al borde de = on the edge/verge of. Al borde de un ataque de nervios.
items.ex: No te pares en el borde del muelle.
items.exEn: Don't stand on the edge of the pier.

items.use: Lowercase like all months. En febrero = in February.
items.ex: Los carnavales son en febrero.
items.exEn: Carnival is in February.

items.use: Masculine. Verb: suicidarse. Also used figuratively: eso es un suicidio = that's crazy/reckless.
items.ex: La campaña busca prevenir el suicidio.
items.exEn: The campaign aims to prevent suicide.

items.use: Hacer escala = to have a layover. Vuelo sin escalas = nonstop flight. A gran escala = on a large scale.
items.ex: El vuelo hace escala en Bogotá.
items.exEn: The flight has a layover in Bogotá.

items.use: Stress on the first syllable: SÍM-bo-lo.
items.ex: La paloma es un símbolo de paz.
items.exEn: The dove is a symbol of peace.

items.use: Seasons are lowercase. En primavera = in spring.
items.ex: En primavera hay muchas flores.
items.exEn: In spring there are lots of flowers.
items.latam: Panama has no spring; people talk about verano (dry season) and invierno (rainy season).

items.use: A stick or pole. Palo de golf = golf club. Moler a palos = to beat up.
items.ex: El perro trajo un palo.
items.exEn: The dog brought a stick.
items.latam: In Panama, un palo is also slang for a dollar, and echarse un palo = to have a drink.

items.use: Fruta is fruit you eat. Fruto is fruit in the botanical or figurative sense (los frutos del trabajo).
items.ex: Como fruta en el desayuno.
items.exEn: I eat fruit at breakfast.

items.use: A machine part or a system. Mecanismo de defensa = defense mechanism.
items.ex: No entiendo el mecanismo de este reloj.
items.exEn: I don't understand how this watch works.

items.use: Feminine as a noun: una alerta. Estar alerta = to be on alert. Alerta roja = red alert.
items.ex: Hay alerta por lluvias fuertes.
items.exEn: There's an alert for heavy rain.

items.use: A sum of money, or addition in math. En suma = in short.
items.ex: Pagó una gran suma de dinero.
items.exEn: He paid a large sum of money.

items.use: Impacto ambiental = environmental impact. Also a bullet hit.
items.ex: La noticia tuvo un gran impacto.
items.exEn: The news had a big impact.

items.use: Una ronda de cervezas = a round of beers. Segunda ronda = second round. Hacer la ronda = to patrol.
items.ex: Esta ronda la pago yo.
items.exEn: This round is on me.

items.use: Formal or official word. In daily speech: casa or apartamento. Vivienda social = public housing.
items.ex: El precio de la vivienda ha subido mucho.
items.exEn: Housing prices have gone up a lot.

items.use: Usually plural: ¡Felicitaciones! = Congratulations! Also ¡Felicidades!
items.ex: ¡Felicitaciones por tu nuevo trabajo!
items.exEn: Congratulations on your new job!

items.use: Jaque mate = checkmate. In South America, a herbal tea drink. Las mates (f. pl.) = math (Spain slang).
items.ex: Le dio jaque mate en diez jugadas.
items.exEn: She checkmated him in ten moves.
items.latam: Mate the drink is huge in Argentina, Uruguay and Paraguay, but rare in Panama.

items.use: Masculine. Tener sabor a = to taste of. ¿De qué sabor? = What flavor?
items.ex: Este helado tiene sabor a coco.
items.exEn: This ice cream tastes of coconut.

items.use: False friend: a reason to support an idea, or a story's plot. A fight is una discusión.
items.ex: El argumento de la película es muy original.
items.exEn: The film's plot is very original.

items.use: Feminine despite ending in -u: la tribu. Tribus urbanas = urban subcultures.
items.ex: Visitamos una tribu emberá en el río Chagres.
items.exEn: We visited an Emberá tribe on the Chagres River.

items.use: A counter in a bar, a metal bar, or a bar of chocolate. Barra libre = open bar.
items.ex: Nos sentamos en la barra.
items.exEn: We sat at the bar.
items.latam: In Latin America la barra also means a group of fans (barra brava).

items.use: De categoría = high-class. Hotel de primera categoría = first-class hotel.
items.ex: Es un restaurante de mucha categoría.
items.exEn: It's a very classy restaurant.

items.use: A stain on clothes or a spot on the skin. Verb: manchar.
items.ex: Tengo una mancha de café en la camisa.
items.exEn: I have a coffee stain on my shirt.

items.use: Mostly used in Spain. Also a hotel housekeeper (camarera de piso).
items.ex: El camarero nos trajo la cuenta.
items.exEn: The waiter brought us the check.
items.latam: In Panama and most of LatAm, say mesero/mesera.

items.use: Dimensiones (pl.) = measurements. Also scale of a problem: la dimensión del problema.
items.ex: ¿Cuáles son las dimensiones de la mesa?
items.exEn: What are the table's dimensions?

items.use: Saludos = regards (end of an email). Dale saludos a tu mamá = say hi to your mom.
items.ex: Dale saludos a tu familia de mi parte.
items.exEn: Say hi to your family for me.

items.use: A layer, a coat of paint (una capa de pintura), or a cape. Capa de ozono = ozone layer.
items.ex: Le dimos dos capas de pintura a la pared.
items.exEn: We gave the wall two coats of paint.

items.use: Avances tecnológicos = technological advances. Also a movie trailer or news preview.
items.ex: Ha habido grandes avances en la medicina.
items.exEn: There have been great advances in medicine.

items.use: Good or bad pride. Ser un orgullo para = to be a source of pride for. Adjective: orgulloso de.
items.ex: Mis hijos son mi orgullo.
items.exEn: My children are my pride and joy.

items.use: Gender changes meaning: la coma = comma; el coma = coma (medical). Decimals use punto or coma depending on country.
items.ex: Aquí falta una coma.
items.exEn: There's a comma missing here.

items.use: Spelled with xc. A excepción de = except for. Sin excepción = without exception.
items.ex: Todos vinieron, a excepción de Juan.
items.exEn: Everyone came except Juan.

items.use: Margin of a page or profit. Dejar al margen = to leave out. Plural adds an accent: márgenes.
items.ex: No hay margen de error.
items.exEn: There's no margin for error.

items.use: Hacer un encargo = to do an errand or order something. Por encargo = made to order.
items.ex: Hice un encargo por internet.
items.exEn: I ordered something online.

items.use: Dar un salto = to jump. Salto de agua = waterfall. Verb: saltar.
items.ex: Dio un salto de alegría.
items.exEn: He jumped for joy.

items.use: A poster or sign. Also a drug cartel (cártel or cartel).
items.ex: Pegaron un cartel en la puerta.
items.exEn: They put a poster on the door.
items.latam: For a street sign in Panama, people also say letrero.

items.use: Masculine. Also heavy metal music (el metal).
items.ex: La mesa es de metal.
items.exEn: The table is made of metal.

items.use: Estar en huelga = to be on strike. Hacer huelga = to go on strike. Huelga de hambre = hunger strike.
items.ex: Los maestros están en huelga.
items.exEn: The teachers are on strike.

items.use: False friend: a court judgment, not a grammar sentence (that is oración or frase).
items.ex: El juez dictó sentencia ayer.
items.exEn: The judge handed down the ruling yesterday.

items.use: The metal. The clothes iron is la plancha. De hierro = made of iron, or very strong.
items.ex: La espinaca tiene mucho hierro.
items.exEn: Spinach has a lot of iron.

items.use: Tasa de interés = interest rate. Tasa de desempleo = unemployment rate. Don't confuse with taza (cup).
items.ex: La tasa de desempleo bajó este año.
items.exEn: The unemployment rate fell this year.

items.use: Like reto. Un gran desafío = a big challenge. Verb: desafiar.
items.ex: Aprender chino es un desafío.
items.exEn: Learning Chinese is a challenge.

items.use: A wardrobe or cupboard. Salir del armario = to come out (as gay).
items.ex: Guarda la ropa en el armario.
items.exEn: Put the clothes away in the closet.
items.latam: In Panama, a built-in closet is usually el clóset.

items.use: Un trozo de pan/pastel = a piece of bread/cake. Similar to pedazo.
items.ex: ¿Quieres un trozo de pastel?
items.exEn: Do you want a piece of cake?

items.use: Hacer un experimento = to do an experiment. Experiencia is not the same.
items.ex: Hicimos un experimento en clase de ciencias.
items.exEn: We did an experiment in science class.

items.use: Always feminine, even for a male snake. Culebra is a common everyday word too.
items.ex: Vimos una serpiente en el sendero.
items.exEn: We saw a snake on the trail.

items.use: Masculine. Festival de cine/música.
items.ex: Vamos al festival de jazz en enero.
items.exEn: We're going to the jazz festival in January.

items.use: Gender trap: feminine (la miel). Luna de miel = honeymoon.
items.ex: Le pongo miel al té.
items.exEn: I put honey in my tea.

items.use: Tener mucha imaginación = to be very imaginative. Son imaginaciones tuyas = you're imagining things.
items.ex: Los niños tienen mucha imaginación.
items.exEn: Children have a lot of imagination.

items.use: Tener paciencia = to be patient. Perder la paciencia = to lose patience.
items.ex: Ten paciencia, ya viene el bus.
items.exEn: Be patient, the bus is coming.

items.use: Ethnic race, or a dog/cat breed. ¿De qué raza es tu perro? = What breed is your dog?
items.ex: ¿De qué raza es tu perro?
items.exEn: What breed is your dog?

items.use: Gender trap: masculine despite -a (el poema), like el problema and el tema.
items.ex: Escribió un poema para su madre.
items.exEn: He wrote a poem for his mother.

items.use: Nadar en la piscina. In Panama and Central America you also hear 'la piscina'; 'pileta' is Argentina.
items.ex: El edificio tiene una piscina en la azotea.
items.exEn: The building has a pool on the roof.
items.latam: Mexico says 'alberca'; Argentina 'pileta'. Panama uses 'piscina'.

items.use: Usually means a street protest, not 'manifestation'. Hacer / convocar una manifestación.
items.ex: Hubo una manifestación frente a la Asamblea.
items.exEn: There was a protest in front of the Assembly.

items.use: Contar un chiste = tell a joke. 'El chiste es...' = the point is...
items.ex: Mi tío siempre cuenta chistes malos.
items.exEn: My uncle always tells bad jokes.

items.use: Hacer un depósito = make a deposit (bank). Also a storage room or warehouse.
items.ex: Hice un depósito en el banco esta mañana.
items.exEn: I made a deposit at the bank this morning.

items.use: Often positive: 'me hace ilusión' = I'm excited about it. Hacerse ilusiones = get your hopes up.
items.ex: No te hagas ilusiones, quizás no venga.
items.exEn: Don't get your hopes up, maybe he won't come.
items.latam: 'Me hace ilusión' is very Spain; in Panama people more often say 'me emociona'.

items.use: Literatura latinoamericana, clase de literatura.
items.ex: Estudio literatura en la universidad.
